job.title: Quality Manager - Knowledge AI Required (Clark, Pampanga)
job.description:
Company Description:

We are seeking an operational Knowledge AI Quality Lead from our BPO partner to oversee, monitor, and elevate the performance of our AI-driven customer service tools and hybrid support workflows. Positioned within the partner's contact center operations, this role ensures that automated workflows, virtual assistants, agent copilots, and human-assist handovers deliver reliable, accurate, and compliant customer experiences.

The ideal candidate combines operational contact center auditing expertise with a deep understanding of AI conversational dynamics, acting as the frontline bridge between real-time vendor performance data and client-side engineering, product, and knowledge teams.

Job Description:

AI QA Framework & Testing

  • Operationalize and execute client-approved QA frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and test scripts tailored for AI chatbots, virtual agents, and copilot tools.
  • Perform routine pre-release User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing across prompt deployments, Knowledge Base (KB) updates, and automated workflow releases within the operational environment.

Operational Auditing & Performance Monitoring

  • Conduct daily audits of live AI-driven conversations, automated resolutions, and self-service interactions to detect intent misclassifications, system hallucinations, incorrect policy applications, or journey drops.
  • Audit the handover bridge between AI and Human-Assist agents to evaluate context retention, CRM data pass-through accuracy, and agent handle times post-transfer.

Closed-Loop Vendor Feedback & Defect Analysis

  • Perform root-cause defect analysis on resolution failures, escalation spikes, and recurring customer friction points.
  • Synthesize audit data into actionable weekly reports; feed continuous improvement insights to Client AI Automation Leads, KB Managers, and Product Engineering for system retuning and sprint updates.
  • Identify out-of-scope traveler queries and KB content gaps, recommending new intents and articles to safely broaden containment coverage.

Operational Metrics & SLA Compliance

  • Measure, track, and report on primary operational and AI quality KPIs:
  • Intent Recognition Accuracy
  • Resolution Precision & Answer Accuracy
  • Containment Rate & Defect Rate
  • Handover Context Retention Accuracy
  • Traveler Sentiment Score (TSS) / CSAT Impact
  • Hold operational teams and frontline agents accountable for adhering to updated AI copilot workflows and knowledge standards.

Qualifications:

Experience

  • Contact Center QA Background: 2+ years of experience in quality management, operational auditing, or process improvement within a high-volume BPO/contact center environment.
  • AI & Automation Auditing: Demonstrated experience testing, auditing, or evaluating AI chatbots, conversational flows, copilot integrations, or workflow automation tools.
  • Travel Industry (Preferred): Prior experience in travel, hospitality, or tech-enabled customer support operations is strongly preferred.
  • Methodology: Familiarity with operational process improvement tools (Lean, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis / 5 Whys).

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Conversational AI Fluency: Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP/NLU) behavior, intent mapping structures, and failure patterns (e.g., hallucination, drift, misclassification).
  • Analytical & Data-Driven: Ability to turn transcript audits, CSS feedback, and performance dashboard data into actionable insights, using AI tools to support analysis and validating outputs for accuracy and relevance.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Clear written and verbal reporting skills to present quality defects and technical feedback to both BPO leadership and client technical teams.
  • Quality Standard-Setting: Meticulous attention to detail with an unyielding commitment to brand trust and effortless traveler resolution.

Additional Information:

Interested candidates must be willing to work onsite in Clark, Pampanga.

job.title: Security & Safety Lead | Egypt | Alexandria | Matajer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a dedicated Safety & Security Lead who will protect the employees, assets, information and reputation of the organization at our Alexandria site. In this role, you will implement and monitor physical security and safety policies, procedures and guidelines in line with the Global Security Manual (GSM), the company’s health and safety standards and client-specific directives (e.g., PCI DSS), and serve as the site’s Local Safety Officer.

Job Description:

In this role, you'll be responsible for the following site & security management aspects:

  • Implement company and client security and safety policies and procedures among employees, contractors, clients and other third parties.
  • Enforce access control: badging, visitor management and escorts, key control, and restricted-zone access (e.g., production floor), with periodic access-rights reviews.
  • Ensure contractors and vendors are pre-registered, escorted in restricted areas and follow work-order protocols.
  • Ensure 99.9% uptime of security systems (CCTV, access control, intrusion alarm) and fire safety systems (fire alarm and detection, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, emergency doors, FM200, VESDA, etc.) by:
  • Completing the manufacturers’ recommended maintenance;
  • Performing Level 1 troubleshooting and escalating repairs to vendors;
  • Coordinating preventive maintenance and repairs with the site facilities team.
  • Supervise the security guard force: deployment, shift coverage and handover, opening and closing procedures, training and regular performance reviews.
  • Conduct floor checks, including clean-desk and media/document-handling inspections, and follows up on violations and corrective actions.
  • Conduct a monthly internal compliance audit of client physical security requirements in accordance with the MSA or SOW, and maintains audit-ready records and evidence (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001, client audits) through to closure of findings.
  • Review access logs and CCTV footage to support investigations while preserving evidence, and documents incidents with root cause and corrective actions.
  • Collate daily and monthly site security and safety reports, escalates issues promptly and recommends security technology improvements.
  • Support emergency drills and evacuation exercises, and liaises with law enforcement, emergency and fire services as required.
  • Assist the Geo Head – Security & Safety with incident investigations and reports, and with the security system design of new projects within the area of responsibility.
  • Promote security and safety awareness, including through new hire orientation (NHO), and stays current through security and safety meetings and forums.

Work directly with the Global Health & Safety Manager to:

  • Monitor the site’s compliance with the company’s OHS policy and procedures.
  • Conduct site safety inspections and resolve unsafe or unhealthy conditions immediately.
  • Investigate incidents and ensure approved corrective and preventive actions are implemented on time.
  • Deliver safety induction for all new outsourced staff and vendors

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or armed forces veteran status.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security and safety; experience in a BPO, contact center or other PCI-regulated environment preferred.
  • Fluency in English and the local language(s) of the site.
  • Ability to work rotating shifts and respond to after-hours incidents.

Certifications & Training

  • Training in first aid, fire safety and emergency management.
  • A recognized security professional certification (e.g., ASIS) is preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Working knowledge of CCTV, access control and visitor management, intrusion alarm and fire safety systems, including basic troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with physical security controls under PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and client audit requirements.
  • Working knowledge of computers and MS Office; clear, accurate incident and report writing.
  • Reliable supervision of outsourced guard teams, with attention to detail, composure and sound judgment during incidents.

job.title: Talent Sourcing Supervisor – Enterprise & Technical Hiring (Taguig)
job.description:
Company Description:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud Engineering. Advanced Analytics.
For Enterprises, these are key factors of success. For us, they're our core expertise.

We work with global iconic brands. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technologies and business process excellence. At the heart of it all is Digital Engineering - the foundation that powers rapid innovation and scalable business transformation.

We've created 363 unique and independent inventions, 250 of which are AI-based and rolled up under several patent grants in critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless "as-a-service" model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. With proven strategies and agile execution, we don't just enable change - we engineer digital outcomes.

Sutherland
Digital Outcomes.

Job Description:

Position Overview

Sutherland is seeking a results-driven Talent Sourcing Supervisor with proven expertise in enterprise/B2B and technical recruitment. The role will lead sourcing strategies and develop qualified talent pipelines for Customer Success Managers (CSM), IT Service Desk / IT Support, Network Operations Center (NOC), and Sales Development Representatives (SDR). The successful candidate will combine domain expertise, market intelligence, team leadership, and stakeholder partnership to deliver quality candidates aligned with business and client hiring requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies and sustainable talent pipelines aligned with hiring forecasts, client requirements, and recruitment timelines.
  • Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, referrals, social media, competitor mapping, and other digital sourcing channels to identify qualified candidates.
  • Translate job requirements into candidate profiles, sourcing plans, and engagement strategies, including alternative talent pools for hard-to-fill roles.

2. Enterprise/B2B & Technical Domain Expertise

  • Source Customer Success Managers with enterprise account management, customer retention, renewals, product adoption, and stakeholder management experience.
  • Identify IT Service Desk / IT Support and NOC professionals with relevant troubleshooting, incident management, network monitoring, and infrastructure support skills.
  • Build SDR pipelines targeting candidates with B2B prospecting, outbound sales, lead qualification, CRM, and pipeline generation experience.

3. Talent Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct talent market research covering candidate availability, salary benchmarks, competitor hiring activity, and sourcing challenges.
  • Develop talent maps to identify target employers, relevant locations, and transferable talent pools.
  • Recommend sourcing strategies based on talent supply, compensation competitiveness, hiring feasibility, and market risks.

4. Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop sourcing specialists to improve research capabilities, candidate engagement, productivity, and pipeline conversion.
  • Establish sourcing targets and monitor funnel metrics, including qualified submissions, interview conversion, offer acceptance, and hiring outcomes.
  • Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions to improve sourcing efficiency and delivery.

5. Stakeholder Partnership & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with recruiters, Talent Acquisition leaders, hiring managers, and operations stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with hiring priorities.
  • Provide regular updates on pipeline readiness, market constraints, and hiring risks while recommending solutions to improve candidate conversion.
  • Optimize sourcing processes through recruitment technology, analytics, automation, and standardized sourcing playbooks.

Qualifications:

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of recruitment or talent sourcing experience, with substantial exposure to specialized enterprise/B2B or technical hiring.
  • At least 2 years of experience leading, supervising, or mentoring recruitment or sourcing teams.
  • Proven sourcing track record in one or more of these areas: Customer Success / Enterprise Account Management, IT Service Desk / IT Support, NOC / Network Support or SDR / B2B Lead Generation.
  • Proficiency in LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, talent mapping, digital sourcing, ATS, and recruitment analytics.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills. BPO, IT services, SaaS, telecommunications, or technology industry experience is an advantage.
  • Hybrid setup, 3-days onsite, 2-days work from home. May change to full onsite depending on ramp volume.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland:

Job Description:

The North American Director of Influencer Relations role directly adds to our pipeline and impacts the successful closure of business through partnerships and invitations to participate in competitive bidding processes. In addition to building trusted relationships between sourcing advisors and our vertical and horizontal business heads, this role will grow, enhance, and curate the 360° relationship between our Verticals and Horizontals and the analysts’ community. They will continuously modify their patch of analysts and advisors to align with the needs of their internal customers.

This role additionally plays a critical role in amplifying our Brand and reputation across these two communities and, subsequently, out to the market. The ideal candidate will possess a combination of strategic thinking, relationship-building skills, and a proactive approach to expanding Sutherland’s presence and success in the market. They will have existing relationships in geographically based sourcing advisory firms and strong roots in business development.

ROLE SUMMARY AND OVERVIEW

In this Director-level role, you’ll lead the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy to engage sourcing advisors and analyst firms across North America. Your mission is to increase Sutherland’s inclusion in RFPs, deepen joint selling opportunities, and ensure that our capabilities are well-positioned in advisor recommendations and analyst coverage.

You will serve as the key interface between Sutherland’s industry and functional leaders and the influencer ecosystem. This includes customizing and continuously evolving the analyst/advisor engagement plan to ensure alignment with internal priorities. You’ll also be responsible for amplifying the company’s market presence through trusted third-party endorsements and insights, while ensuring that external messaging reinforces Sutherland’s differentiation and competitive edge.

This role requires a deep understanding of the North American advisory landscape, along with a demonstrated ability to drive influence, build credibility, and deliver measurable impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Influencer Engagement Strategy

  • Develop and execute a dynamic engagement strategy with North American sourcing advisors and analyst firms.
  • Drive invitations to competitive bids and elevate Sutherland’s participation in advisor-led buying decisions.

Relationship Management & Growth

  • Build and maintain high-value, trust-based relationships with sourcing advisors and industry analysts.
  • Evolve a portfolio of key influencers, regularly curating engagement activities to reflect internal strategic shifts.

Internal Alignment & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to internal Vertical and Horizontal leaders, aligning influencer strategy with business objectives.
  • Facilitate analyst and advisor interactions including capability briefings, feedback sessions, and GtM alignment discussions.

Brand Amplification & Reputation Management

  • Enhance Sutherland’s brand recognition across analyst and advisor channels.
  • Shape market perception through targeted engagements, published research, and third-party validations.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Track and report on influencer engagement effectiveness, bid influence, and market reach.
  • Continuously optimize influencer strategies based on data-driven insights and feedback from internal teams.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or a related field (MBA preferred).

  • 10+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or influencer relations, preferably within the European market.
  • Strong existing relationships with regional sourcing advisory firms and industry analysts.
  • Deep understanding of Digital Engineering, emerging technologies, and the European business landscape.
  • Experience in executing Go-to-Market (GtM) strategies and competitive positioning.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in managing teams and stakeholder relationships.

Critical Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking & Market Insight – Ability to develop structured programs that align with business growth objectives.
  • Relationship Management & Influence – Proven ability to cultivate and maintain high-value relationships with key industry influencers.
  • Leadership & Team Building – Experience managing and mentoring high-performing teams.
  • Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making – Skilled in tracking, measuring, and refining influencer engagement strategies.
  • Communication & Executive Presence – Strong ability to represent Sutherland in high-stakes discussions with external advisors and analysts.

Key Result Areas (KRAs):

Pipeline Contribution

  • Drive advisor-led bid participation and joint sales opportunities to grow the revenue pipeline.

Influencer Engagement

  • Strengthen and expand trusted relationships with key advisors and analysts across North America.

Internal Stakeholder Alignment

  • Ensure influencer strategies support the goals of Vertical and Horizontal leadership teams.

Market Reputation & Brand Influence

  • Amplify Sutherland’s presence through analyst coverage and advisor feedback loops.

Strategic Feedback Loop

  • Provide internal stakeholders with relevant market insights and third-party perspectives to shape offerings and messaging.

Performance Measurement

  • Track key engagement KPIs and refine strategy to ensure high ROI from influencer activities.

job.title: Project Coordinator - Migration & Implementation
job.description:
Company Description:

We are seeking a highly organized and dependable Professional Services Project Coordinator - Migration & Implementation to support the successful delivery of client migration and implementation projects. In this role, you will work closely with clients, technical resources, and internal teams to help ensure projects remain organized, properly documented, and on schedule from kickoff through completion.

Specifically, this position will focus on supporting the implementation and migration of our existing, currently onboarded Archiving customers to the 6.0 AWS environment. You will coordinate and execute customer migrations, ensuring a smooth transition from the current environment to the new AWS-based platform while minimizing disruption to customer operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong organizational and communication skills, be comfortable working with both technical teams and client stakeholders, and possess the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced Professional Services environment. Experience supporting technology migrations, software implementations, and technical Professional Services engagements is preferred.

Job Description:

  • Migration & Implementation Management: Coordinate migration and implementation projects, including project kickoffs, schedules, meetings, milestones, and deliverables. Plan and execute migrations of existing, onboarded Archiving customers to the 6.0 AWS environment.
  • Coordination & Communication: Coordinate migration activities, timelines, requirements, and resources with internal technical teams and customer stakeholders. Facilitate clear communication between clients, technical teams, and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle to ensure required information, access, and resources are available when needed.
  • Validation & Quality Assurance: Validate customer configurations, data integrity, and functionality throughout the migration process to ensure successful implementation, testing, and customer transition to the new environment.
  • Troubleshooting & Escalation: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration-related issues. Identify potential scheduling issues, delays, or dependencies and escalate them to the appropriate team when necessary.
  • Project Tracking & Documentation: Maintain migration documentation, status reporting, and project tracking. Track action items, dependencies, outstanding requirements, and completion dates.
  • Scheduling & Support: Assist with scheduling resources and coordinating migration, implementation, validation, and project closeout activities. Support multiple client engagements simultaneously while maintaining accurate and organized project records.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure migrations are completed efficiently and according to established standards.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Professional and effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Technical knowledge of Windows, Microsoft software, and Active Directory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate customer-facing implementation activities.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer migrations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort working with technical teams and client stakeholders in a fast-paced Professional Services environment

Asset Knowledge

  • Experience supporting technology migrations, software implementations, and technical Professional Services engagements.
  • AWS cloud environment experience.
  • Quick platform/application experience.
  • Microsoft Copilot.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation.

Additional Information:

  • Position Type: Contract
  • Contract Duration: Through September 2027, with potential for extension based on business and project requirements.
  • Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, working Eastern Time (ET).
  • Available Shifts:
  • 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. ET
  • 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. ET

You must be eligible to work in the US at time of application.

job.title: Sr. Data Analyst | Canada | Remote
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland:

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

Job Description:

**CANADA BASED**(remote)

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be a key driver of insight and innovation within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team. We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who thrives on turning complex scientific and operational data into clear, actionable intelligence. In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. Data Analyst you will be focused on:

Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

In this role, primary responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
  • Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
  • Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
  • Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
  • Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
  • Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

Qualifications:

We are looking for the following minimum qualifications for this role:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
  • Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
  • Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
  • Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
  • Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.
  • MUST be based in Canada

Technical Expertise required:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Data Analyst specializing in the Data & Analytics discipline, preferably in a senior or lead role;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
  • Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy
  • Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology.

Additional Information:

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Contract Network Field Support Engineer to provide onsite
remote hands support for multiple office across the United States. The engineer will work
closely with our global Network Engineering team, which remotely manages and supports the
U.S. infrastructure from the APAC/EMEA region. The primary responsibility of this role is to
perform onsite physical activities related to network infrastructure refresh, deployment,
migration, and replacement projects while coordinating with remote Network Engineers through
Webex or similar collaboration platforms. This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer with
experience in network hardware installation, cabling, rack and stack operations, device
replacement, troubleshooting, and datacenter support activities.Contract Position (3 Months) United States (Travel Required) (USA – Tulsa, USA – Torrance, USA – Clifton, USA –
Springfield, USA - Sully Trail)

Qualifications:

Logistics and Asset Verification
 Visit various company offices across the United States as required.
 Verify delivery of networking equipment upon arrival at site.
 Inspect delivered equipment for physical damage, completeness, and accuracy against
shipment documentation.
 Coordinate with vendors, local site contacts, and the Network Engineering team
regarding equipment receipt and deployment schedules.
 Maintain records and photographs of delivered hardware for inventory and project
documentation purposes.
Network Equipment Installation and Replacement
 Perform physical replacement of network infrastructure equipment (Cisco routers, Cisco
Catalyst switches.)
 Remove existing network devices from racks and cabinets.
 Rack and mount new equipment following provided guidelines.
 Install power supplies, stacking modules, transceivers, and network interface modules
as required.
 Label equipment and cabling according to company standards.
Cabling and Physical Connectivity
 Disconnect existing network and power cabling from legacy devices.

 Reconnect and organize copper and fiber-optic cabling to newly installed equipment.
 Verify cable labeling and connectivity.
 Perform basic cable tracing and cable management activities.
 Ensure all physical connections are properly secured and documented.
Remote Hands Support
 Establish console connectivity to network devices using console cables and laptops.
 Provide remote console access to Network Engineers using Cisco Webex, Microsoft
Teams, or equivalent remote collaboration tools.
 Follow detailed instructions from remote Network Engineers during migration and
cutover activities.
 Execute physical commands under remote supervision, including:
o Power cycling equipment
o Moving network cables
o Connecting console sessions
o Verifying hardware status LEDs
o Replacing transceivers and modules
o Verifying link status
Migration and Implementation Support
 Participate in scheduled maintenance windows, often during evenings, weekends, or off-
business hours.
 Support network refresh and migration activities.
 Assist with testing and validation activities after device deployment.
 Coordinate closely with remote engineers throughout the migration process until
successful completion.
Site Documentation and Reporting
 Capture photos before, during, and after installation activities.
 Document rack elevations and cable connections.
 Provide status reports and progress updates to project stakeholders.
 Report any onsite issues, risks, or blockers immediately to the project team.
Experience
 Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure.
 Experience working in datacenters, server rooms, or enterprise office environments.
 Proven experience performing rack-and-stack activities.
 Experience replacing network hardware during maintenance windows.
 Experience working with remote engineering teams.
Technical Skills

job.title: Security & Safety Lead
job.description:
Company Description:

This position will protect the employees, assets, information and reputation of the organization at the assigned site(s). He will Implement and monitor physical security and safety policies, procedures and guidelines in line with the Global Security Manual (GSM), the company’s health and safety standards and client-specific directives (e.g., PCI DSS),and serve as the site’s Local Safety Officer.

Job Description:

Site Security Management

  • Implements company and client security and safety policies and procedures among employees, contractors, clients and other third parties.
  • Enforces access control: badging, visitor management and escorts, key control, and restricted-zone access (e.g., production floor), with periodic access-rights reviews.
  • Ensures contractors and vendors are pre-registered, escorted in restricted areas and follow work-order protocols.
  • Ensures 99.9% uptime of security systems (CCTV, access control, intrusion alarm) and fire safety systems (fire alarm and detection, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, emergency doors, FM200, VESDA, etc.) by:
  • Completing the manufacturers’ recommended maintenance;
  • Performing Level 1 troubleshooting and escalating repairs to vendors;
  • Coordinating preventive maintenance and repairs with the site facilities team.
  • Supervises the security guard force: deployment, shift coverage and handover, opening and closing procedures, training and regular performance reviews.
  • Conducts floor checks, including clean-desk and media/document-handling inspections, and follows up on violations and corrective actions.
  • Conducts a monthly internal compliance audit of client physical security requirements in accordance with the MSA or SOW, and maintains audit-ready records and evidence (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001, client audits) through to closure of findings.
  • Reviews access logs and CCTV footage to support investigations while preserving evidence, and documents incidents with root cause and corrective actions.
  • Collates daily and monthly site security and safety reports, escalates issues promptly and recommends security technology improvements.
  • Supports emergency drills and evacuation exercises, and liaises with law enforcement, emergency and fire services as required.
  • Assists the Geo Head – Security & Safety with incident investigations and reports, and with the security system design of new projects within the area of responsibility.
  • Promotes security and safety awareness, including through new hire orientation (NHO), and stays current through security and safety meetings and forums.

Health & Safety Management (Local Safety Officer)

Works directly with the Global Health & Safety Manager to:

  • Monitor the site’s compliance with the company’s OHS policy and procedures.
  • Conduct site safety inspections and resolve unsafe or unhealthy conditions immediately.
  • Investigate incidents and ensure approved corrective and preventive actions are implemented on time.
  • Deliver safety induction for all new outsourced staff and vendors.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or armed forces veteran status.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security and safety; experience in a BPO, contact center or other PCI-regulated environment preferred.
  • Fluency in English and the local language(s) of the site.
  • Ability to work rotating shifts and respond to after-hours incidents.

Certifications & Training

  • Training in first aid, fire safety and emergency management.
  • A recognized security professional certification (e.g., ASIS) is preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Working knowledge of CCTV, access control and visitor management, intrusion alarm and fire safety systems, including basic troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with physical security controls under PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and client audit requirements.
  • Working knowledge of computers and MS Office; clear, accurate incident and report writing.
  • Reliable supervision of outsourced guard teams, with attention to detail, composure and sound judgment during incidents.

Job Description:

The ADA & LOA Specialist manages the interactive accommodation process and employee leaves of absence for employees and job applicants. The role applies the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), ADAAA, Pregnant Workers Fairness Act (PWFA), Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and applicable state and local leave and accommodation laws.

This role works with employees, people managers, HR business partners, legal counsel, healthcare providers, and third-party leave administrators. The goal is to administer leaves accurately and identify reasonable accommodations that remove workplace barriers while maintaining business operations.

Key responsibilities

  • Interactive process management
  • Facilitate the interactive accommodation dialogue from initial request through case resolution.
  • Conduct intake interviews with employees to understand functional limitations, job tasks, and specific accommodation needs.
  • Leave of absence administration
  • Manage a caseload of FMLA, state leave, short- and long-term disability, military, and personal leaves from request through return-to-work.
  • Determine eligibility and issue eligibility, rights and responsibilities, and designation notices within required timelines.
  • Track intermittent leave usage and reconcile it against attendance and timekeeping records.
  • Coordinate with third-party leave administrators, payroll, and benefits so pay and benefits continue correctly during leave.
  • Manage return-to-work, including fitness-for-duty documentation and the transition to accommodation when restrictions remain or leave is exhausted.
  • Medical review and analysis
  • Review and evaluate medical documentation from healthcare providers to verify coverage under ADA guidelines and assess functional restrictions.
  • Review leave medical certifications for completeness and follow up on missing or unclear information.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of employee health information in compliance with ADA, FMLA, and HIPAA standards, keeping medical files separate from personnel files.
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Partner with department leaders and HR to assess essential job functions and evaluate accommodation feasibility (e.g., adaptive equipment, flexible scheduling, remote work, duty modifications).
  • Advise managers on appropriate support techniques, compliance standards, and non-discriminatory practices.
  • Advise managers on attendance, job protection, and return-to-work questions tied to leave.
  • Case tracking and compliance
  • Maintain accurate, centralized records for accommodation and leave cases, tracking outcomes, temporary accommodations, leave dates, and review dates in the HR case management system.
  • Ensure consistent, timely processing of requests in accordance with federal and state statutory timelines.
  • Flag compliance risks and escalate complex cases to leadership.
  • Prepare regular reports on leave volume, case aging, and accommodation trends.
  • Program support and education
  • Help update disability accommodation and leave policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Assist in delivering training to managers and HR teams on disability inclusion, leave requirements, and interactive process best practices.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience in HR operations, leave management, or disability services, with direct experience handling ADA accommodation and leave of absence cases.
  • Knowledge: Deep working knowledge of federal and state disability and leave laws (ADA/ADAAA, FMLA, PWFA, and state-specific regulations such as California FEHA and CFRA, and state paid family and medical leave programs).
  • Skills:
  • Excellent empathetic communication, intake interviewing, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex medical notes against job descriptions.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload with competing statutory deadlines.
  • Proficiency in HRIS and case management tools and experience working with third-party leave administrators.

job.title: Sr. BI & Data Analyst | Remote | Canada
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland:

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

Job Description:

As a Senior BI & Data Analyst, you’ll be a key driver of insight and innovation within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team. We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who thrives on turning complex scientific and operational data into clear, actionable intelligence. In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. BI & Data Analyst you will be focused on:

Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

In this role, primary responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
  • Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
  • Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
  • Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
  • Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
  • Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

Qualifications:

We are looking for the following minimum qualifications for this role:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
  • Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
  • Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
  • Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
  • Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.

Technical Expertise required:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Data Analyst specializing in the Data & Analytics discipline, preferably in a senior or lead role;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
  • Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy
  • Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description:

The Facility-Fee Emergency Department Medical Coder is responsible for the accurate review, abstraction, and assignment of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, facility-specific charging methodologies, and applicable modifiers for Emergency Department (ED) facility encounters. This role ensures coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, appropriate reimbursement, and adherence to client-specific coding guidelines, payer requirements, and industry standards.

The coder will review clinical documentation, emergency department records, physician documentation, nursing notes, ancillary reports, and charging information to accurately capture facility services rendered during emergency department visits. The position requires strong knowledge of facility fee coding, emergency department leveling methodologies, and outpatient reimbursement regulations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review emergency department medical records to assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes, CPT/HCPCS procedure codes, and applicable modifiers.
  • Accurately assign facility Evaluation and Management (E/M) levels in accordance with client-specific emergency department leveling guidelines and facility charging methodologies, including knowledge of the ACEP tool.
  • Analyze documentation from nursing staff, physicians, ancillary departments, and diagnostic services to ensure complete code assignment and charge capture.
  • Apply official coding guidelines, CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, and payer-specific requirements.
  • Review accounts for appropriate assignment of procedural services and injections/infusions when applicable.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies and communicate within the appropriate channels regarding coding clarification needs.
  • Maintain compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational coding policies.
  • Participate in coding quality reviews, audits, educational initiatives, and process improvement activities.
  • Remain current on coding updates, reimbursement changes, and regulatory requirements affecting emergency department facility coding.
  • Collaborate with coding leadership, auditors, and client representatives to resolve coding-related issues.

Qualifications:

To qualify you must possess:

  • At least 2+ years of relevant facility-fee outpatient coding experience, specifically in Emergency Department services. Injection and Infusion experience required.
  • Active AAPC or AHIMA coding certification required.
  • Proven ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote environment
  • Epic experience strongly preferred.
  • Other facility-fee and physician-fee medical coding experience a plus

job.title: Training and Quality Lead
job.description:
Company Description:

We are seeking an operational Training & Quality Lead from our BPO partner to ensure frontline agents deliver accurate, compliant, and effortless traveler experiences. Positioned within the partner's contact center operations, this role owns two connected outcomes: interactions consistently meet client quality standards, and agents are trained, certified, and coached to apply policies, processes, and knowledge resources correctly.

The ideal candidate combines contact center quality auditing and training delivery expertise, acting as the frontline bridge between vendor performance data, agent readiness, and client-side operations, product, and knowledge teams — closing the loop from defect detection to process fix to agent behavior change.

Job Description:

Quality Framework & Calibration

  • Operationalize and execute client-approved QA frameworks, evaluation forms, and scoring guidelines across voice, chat, and email channels.
  • Lead regular calibration sessions with client QA, BPO QA analysts, and team leads to maintain scoring consistency across sites.
  • Review policy, process, and Knowledge Base (KB) updates before release to confirm accuracy and agent usability.

Training Design & Agent Enablement

  • Design and deliver onboarding, nesting, upskill, and refresher training for new hires, tenured agents, and team leads.
  • Translate policy, process, and KB updates into change-management content: release notes, job aids, quick-reference guides, and short refresher sessions delivered before go-live.
  • Build scenario-based roleplays, simulations, and assessments within nesting and onboarding curricula.
  • Run knowledge checks and certification assessments to confirm agent readiness before production.
  • Equip team leads and coaches with coaching guides tied to audit findings so that behavior gaps are corrected at the floor level.

Operational Auditing & Performance Monitoring

  • Conduct daily audits of live interactions to detect incorrect policy applications, process deviations, knowledge gaps, and journey drops.
  • Audit escalations and transfers to evaluate context handoff, CRM documentation accuracy, and handle times.
  • Audit agent use of KB articles and tools, distinguishing process- or content-driven defects from agent-driven (skill or will) gaps.

Closed-Loop Feedback & Defect Analysis

  • Perform root-cause analysis on resolution failures, escalation spikes, and recurring customer friction points, classifying each as a process, knowledge, system, or training root cause.
  • Synthesize audit data into weekly reports; feed insights to client Operations, KB Managers, and Product teams for process and content improvements.
  • Convert agent-driven defects into targeted training interventions, coaching plans, and refresher content, and track post-intervention improvement.
  • Identify KB content gaps and recurring traveler queries, recommending new or updated articles.

Qualifications:

Experience

  • Contact Center Quality & Training Background: 3+ years in quality management, operational auditing, or training delivery within a high-volume BPO/contact center environment, with hands-on experience in both disciplines strongly preferred.
  • Training Design & Delivery: Proven experience building and facilitating onboarding, nesting, upskill, or refresher programs, including job aids, assessments, and roleplay scenarios.
  • Interaction Auditing: Demonstrated experience auditing voice, chat, or email interactions against defined quality standards and running calibration sessions.
  • Travel Industry (Preferred): Prior experience in travel, hospitality, or tech-enabled customer support operations is strongly preferred.
  • Methodology: Familiarity with process improvement tools (Lean, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis / 5 Whys) and instructional design models (ADDIE or similar); a train-the-trainer or facilitation certification is a plus.

Core Competencies & Skills

job.title: URGENT: Quality Analyst
job.description:
Company Description:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud Engineering. Advanced Analytics.
For Enterprises, these are key factors of success. For us, they're our core expertise.

We work with global iconic brands. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technologies and business process excellence. At the heart of it all is Digital Engineering - the foundation that powers rapid innovation and scalable business transformation.

We've created 363 unique and independent inventions, 250 of which are AI-based and rolled up under several patent grants in critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless "as-a-service" model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. With proven strategies and agile execution, we don't just enable change - we engineer digital outcomes.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a leadership-oriented and self-motivated person to join us as Lead-Customer Experience/Quality Analyst. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Role Overview:

  • The Customer Experience Analyst is responsible to complete the Customer Experience (CX) observations required using the form that was designed for the program.
  • Champions Customer Experience initiatives and actions for assigned teams to ensure continuous improvement.
  • Deliver team-level analysis to assigned team/s and identify opportunities to improve Customer Experience performance (CSAT, Issue Resolution, ASAT)
  • Drive better quality of customer interactions and processes that will lead to customer satisfaction through proper identification of defects and root causes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

A. CE Team Delivery

  1. Improve team performance on Customer Experience metrics (CSAT, Issue Resolution, ASAT) through CE observations and team engagement.
  2. Maintain program expertise by completing required amount of phone time / contact handling hours.
  3. Build consistency and accuracy in evaluating contacts by attending client and internal calibration sessions.

B. Team Development

1. Drive consultant improvement by providing targeted recommendations from CE observations

C. Continuous Improvement Framework Deployment and Analysis

1. Improve performance of assigned focus consultants against CI goal through follow up observations
2. Produce Level 1 analysis for assigned teams (Top Contact Driver, Defects, Lead/Lag)

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • At least 1 to 2 years Quality Analyst Experience in a Call Center Setting.
  • Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn.
  • Fluent in written and verbal English, with the ability to comprehend and effectively communicate with onshore team and external customers who are business professionals.
  • B2 & above communication skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, such as MS-Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Solid understanding of the Quality audit & Coaching process. Ability to observe, analyse and give constructive feedback. Strong customer orientation with a service-oriented attitude. Ability to analyze data, interpret findings, and identify patterns or areas of improvement.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Auto Loan Collections and Customer Service Associate
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Are you an excellent verbal and written communicator, and a great listener? Do you thrive on a team that's focused on finding the best solutions for customers? Can you remain kind and supportive when customers share their concerns about their loan? Do you have prior collections, sales or customer service experience?

We are seeking a motivated and passionate Auto Loan Collections Advisor to join us! If you are looking to build a fulfilling career, and the description above resonates with you, we want to work with you!

Essential Duties in this role:

  • Associates handle inbound or outbound calls with existing customers. Associates should educate customers on account status, attempting to solve customer problems and/or attempting to secure a payment or make payment arrangements. The goal is to help our customers build and retain a strong credit standing and maintain a customer for life.
  • Provide excellent customer service to customers who need assistance in meeting their contract obligations due to unexpected financial obligations.
  • Contact or attempt contact with customers who are delinquent.
  • Overcome objections that customers have about making payments toward their account and help them to understand their account(s) and responsibilities.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with the Loan Servicing team.
  • Meet or exceed production goals
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

What Kind of Associates Are We Looking for?

  • Agile in a fast-past environment.
  • You embody excellent customer service.
  • Team oriented and people-oriented.
  • Critical thinker and quick learner.
  • Has good active listening skills.
  • Professional and persuasive communication and negotiation skills
  • Passionate and goal-oriented
  • Positive emotional resilience and emotional intelligence.
  • Must be self-motivated with strong decision-making and problem solving abilities
  • Flexible and committed to overall goals.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: -

  • Must be 18 years and older.
  • A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE subjects inclusive of English Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. We require all candidates to have a minimum of 3 subjects inclusive of English (CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery).
  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be able to train and / or work onsite.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • See through the eyes of the customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test as needed.

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts.
  • Annual merit increase based on performance.
  • Paid Training whether onsite or in work at home.
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers.
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure.
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually.
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan
  • Lunch benefits and subsidy.
  • Onsite lunch concessionaire at reduced rates.
  • Transportation/ Shuttle Services - Free transportation home for shifts that end after 9:00 pm and pick-ups for shifts that begin before 6am
  • Free On-site medical suite with nurse and medical doctor.
  • Daily Refuel Plan - Robust and dynamic schedule of activities to keep employees energized both at home and in the office.
  • Paid referral program
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement.
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and technical person to join us as Data Engineer who will play a key role in driving our continued product growth and innovation. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!!

Job Description:

The BIA Data Engineer Designs, implements, and maintains complex data engineering solutions in the Business Intelligence and Analytics team.

Responsible for design, development, implementation, testing, documentation, and support of analytical and data solutions/projects requiring data aggregation/data pipelines/ETL/ELT from multiple sources into an efficient reporting mechanism, database/data warehouse using appropriate tools like Informatica, Azure Data Factory, SSIS. This includes interacting with business to gather requirements, analysis, and creation of functional and technical specs, testing, training, escalation, and follow-up.

Support of the applications would include resolving issues reported by users. Issues could be caused by bugs in the application or user errors or programming errors. Resolution process will include, but not limited to, investigate known bugs on software vendor support website, create tickets or service requests with software vendor, develop scripts to fix data issues, make program changes, test fixes and apply the changes to production.

These tasks and activities will be completed with the help and under the guidance of the supervisor. Participation in team and / or project meetings, to schedule work and discuss status, will be required.

The position also requires staying abreast with changes in technology, programming languages, and software development tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Data Pipeline/ETL (40%): Designs and implements data stores and ETL data flows and data pipelines to connect and prepare operational systems data for analytics and business intelligence (BI) systems.
  • Support & Operations (10%): Manages production deployments and automation, monitoring, job control and production support. Works with business users to test programs in Development and Quality. Investigates issues using vendor support website(s).
  • Data Modeling/Designing Datasets (10%): Reviews and understands business requirements for development tasks assigned and applies standard data modelling and design techniques based upon a detailed understanding of requirements.
  • Data Architecture and Technical Infrastructure (10%): Plans and drives the development of data engineering solutions ensuring that solutions balance functional and non-functional requirements. Monitors application of data standards and architectures including security and compliance.
  • SDLC Methodology & Project Management (5%): Contributes to technical transitions between development, testing, and production phases of solutions' lifecycle, and the facilitation of the change control, problem management, and communication processes.
  • Data Governance and Data Quality (5%): Identifies and investigates data quality/integrity problems, determine impact and provide solutions to problems.
  • Metadata Management & Documentation (5%): Documents all processes and mappings related to Data Pipelines work and follows development best practices as adopted by the BIA team
  • End-User Support, Education and Enablement (5%): Contributes to training and Data Literacy initiatives within the team and End user community.
  • Innovation, Continuous Improvement & Optimization (5%): Continuously improves and optimizes existing Data Engineering assets/processes.
  • Partnership and Community Building (5%): Collaborates with other IT teams, Business Community, data scientists and other architects to meet business requirements. Interact with DBAs on data designs optimal for data engineering solutions performance.

Required Skills:

  • Minimum of 4+ years of experience as Data Engineer
  • Development, maintenance, and enhancement of Data Pipelines (ETL/ELT) and processes with thorough knowledge of star/snowflake schemas
  • Developing complex SQL queries and SQL optimization
  • Development experience must be full Life Cycle experience including business requirements gathering, data sourcing, testing/data reconciliation, and deployment within Business Intelligence/Data Warehousing Architecture.
  • Understanding of Data Architecture
  • Knowledge of ETL and data engineering standards and best practices for the design and development of data pipelines and data extract, transform and load processes
  • Design, build and test data products based on feeds from multiple systems, using a range of different storage technologies, access methods or both
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including multi-dimensional models and ETL logic for maintaining star-schemas
  • Good Understanding of concepts and principles of data modelling.
  • Ability to produce, maintain and update relevant data models for specific needs.
  • Can reverse-engineer data models from a live system
  • SQL programming desirable (i.e., stored procedures dev.)
  • Proficient in data analysis, defect identifications and resolutions.
  • Strong professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work with little supervision and within changing priorities.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and troubleshoot problems.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Hybrid work model: In-office on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
  • Working Time: 2:00 PM IST to 11:00 PM IST
  • Work Location: Pune

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the clinical and operational resource for the AO Clinical Claims Program. This role provides expertise on clinical claims processes, medical documentation review, disability management guidelines, quality standards, and client-specific policies and procedures. The SME supports production teams through coaching, training, case consultations, quality improvement initiatives, and process governance to ensure service excellence, compliance, and operational efficiency.

This is a dual-role position that requires the incumbent to function both as a Clinical Claims Associate and as a Subject Matter Expert simultaneously. In addition to providing expert guidance, floor support, coaching, and process expertise, the SME is expected to independently perform the same core clinical claims review and case management responsibilities as other team members. The SME will maintain an assigned production workload and is expected to meet established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance metrics while providing real-time support to the operations team.

The ideal candidate is a licensed US Registered Nurse (USRN) with strong clinical claims experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with operations leaders, quality teams, trainers, and client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Operational Expertise

  • Serve as the primary clinical subject matter expert for disability and clinical claims operations.
  • Interpret and apply client-specific guidelines, medical policies, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review complex cases and provide recommendations to associates and leadership teams.
  • Support accurate evaluation and documentation of clinical claims based on medical evidence and established protocols.
  • Ensure consistency in claims handling and decision-support processes.
  • Perform end-to-end clinical claims review, assessment, and documentation activities consistent with the responsibilities of a Clinical Claims Associate/Analyst.
  • Maintain an assigned production workload and achieve established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance targets.
  • Balance individual case processing responsibilities with SME support, coaching, and escalation management activities.
  • Demonstrate best practices in claims handling, clinical documentation review, and decision-making while serving as a role model for the team.

Team Support and Coaching

  • Provide floor support and real-time assistance to agents and analysts.
  • Conduct case reviews, side-by-side coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend developmental interventions.
  • Act as the escalation point for process-related and clinical questions.
  • Provide support to associates while actively managing a personal caseload and production responsibilities.
  • Serve as a role model by demonstrating effective claims processing techniques, adherence to operational standards, and strong performance outcomes.

Training and Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate refresher sessions and uptraining programs.
  • Assist Training and Operations teams in creating and updating process documentation.
  • Support onboarding activities for new hires.
  • Maintain knowledge repositories and ensure process updates are communicated effectively.

Quality and Compliance

  • Partner with Quality Assurance teams to drive accuracy and compliance metrics.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of clinical policies.
  • Monitor regulatory and client-driven changes impacting operations.
  • Support audit activities and corrective action plans.
  • Lead by example by consistently meeting quality and compliance standards in both production and SME-related responsibilities.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and claim review processes.
  • Analyze trends, defects, and operational challenges.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in implementing process enhancements and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Managers, Quality Analysts, Trainers, Workforce, and Client Partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions when requested.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on operational and clinical findings.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted US Registered Nurse (USRN) license.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of US healthcare experience in one or a combination of the following:
  • Disability Claims
  • Clinical Claims Review
  • Utilization Management (UM)
  • Case Management (CM)
  • Workers' Compensation
  • Medical Review
  • Insurance Claims Operations
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, disease processes, treatment protocols, and clinical documentation review.
  • Strong understanding of disability management and insurance claims processes.
  • Experience working in a healthcare BPO/shared services environment preferred.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willing to work in a shifting schedule and support business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively balance individual production responsibilities with Subject Matter Expert support functions.
  • Proven experience maintaining performance metrics while providing coaching, floor support, guidance, and operational assistance to peers.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, multitasking, and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced clinical operations environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Disability Claims, Group Benefits, or similar insurance accounts.
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement exposure.
  • Experience facilitating training and coaching sessions.
  • Background in quality auditing and process calibration.
  • Leadership or project management experience.

Additional Information:

Internal Qualifications:

  • Must have Annual PDP score of Exceeds Expectations (4) or Outstanding (5)
  • Tenure of at least 12 months on the current role
  • No Active DA

Role Clarification

Important: This is not a dedicated support-only SME position. The selected candidate will be expected to perform the same core clinical claims processing and case review functions as other team members while simultaneously serving as the team's Subject Matter Expert. Success in this role requires balancing production targets, quality expectations, coaching responsibilities, escalation support, and operational excellence.

Job Description:

The Team Manager is responsible for leading a team of USRN Clinical Claims Associates/Specialists supporting Accident & Occupational (AO) Clinical Claims operations. The role will drive operational excellence by ensuring achievement of client metrics, quality standards, service levels, productivity targets, compliance requirements, and employee engagement objectives.

The Team Manager will provide coaching, performance management, clinical guidance, and day-to-day operational leadership to ensure accurate claims processing and exceptional customer outcomes while maintaining regulatory and client standards.

Key Responsibilities

Operations Management

  • Manage the daily operations of assigned clinical claims teams.
  • Monitor and ensure achievement of productivity, quality, accuracy, compliance, and turnaround time targets.
  • Analyze performance trends and implement action plans to address gaps.
  • Ensure adherence to client processes, policies, and standard operating procedures.
  • Support the achievement of account and business objectives.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Clinical Claims Associates/Specialists.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and career development discussions.
  • Manage attendance, adherence, employee engagement, and retention initiatives.
  • Create and maintain a high-performance culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Handle employee relations matters in partnership with HR and Operations leadership.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, data privacy, client requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Conduct audits and reviews to ensure claims are processed accurately and consistently.
  • Drive corrective and preventive action plans for identified performance gaps.
  • Promote adherence to clinical documentation and claims adjudication standards.

Client Management

  • Support Operations Leadership during business reviews and client discussions.
  • Provide timely updates and insights regarding team performance.
  • Participate in calibration sessions and process improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain strong client relationships through consistent delivery of operational commitments.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, productivity, and quality outcomes.
  • Lead process improvement projects and change management initiatives.
  • Drive knowledge-sharing and best-practice implementation across teams.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted US Registered Nurse (USRN) license.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent nursing qualification.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience in a hospital, healthcare, insurance, disability claims, utilization review, case management, or related healthcare setting.
  • Minimum 2 years of people management experience leading healthcare operations, clinical teams, BPO healthcare accounts, or claims operations.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical documentation, and healthcare processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in:
  • Disability Claims Management
  • Clinical Claims Review
  • Utilization Management
  • Case Management
  • Health Insurance Operations
  • Healthcare BPO Operations
  • Experience managing US healthcare or insurance accounts.
  • Lean Six Sigma, Quality, or Process Improvement certification is an advantage.
