job.title: CX Data Analyst and Power BI Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a technically savvy and analytical individual to join our CX Transformation team. This role is a hybrid of a Data Engineer and a Business Intelligence Analyst. You will be the "engine" of our data operations, responsible for the day-to-day execution of insights, dashboard development, and data architecture that powers our client’s CX strategy.

Job Description:

As the CX Data Analyst & Power BI Engineer, you will be the execution layer of our day-to-day data operations. Your primary focus is to manage and monitor our existing reporting suite: running periodic reports to spot emerging trends and summarizing key findings into digestible insights. While the foundation is built, you will be the go-to resource for evolving our tools: updating existing dashboards as business requirements change and occasionally building new dataflows or visualizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trend Analysis & Reporting: Manage the daily/weekly cadence of CX reports, performing deep-dives to identify operational shifts, anomalies, or opportunities.
  • Dashboard Maintenance & Evolution: Serve as the primary owner for existing Power BI reports; update logic, visualizations, and data connections as business requirements evolve.
  • Ad-Hoc Development: Design and build new Power BI dashboards and Dataflows when new business needs or special projects arise.
  • Data Integrity & Summarization: Ensure all periodic data refreshes are successful and accurate, translating complex datasets into clear, visual summaries for the leadership team.
  • Collaborative Optimization: Partner with the Insights Hub Manager to translate strategic goals into technical updates within the Power BI environment.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear logs of reporting updates and data definitions to ensure consistency across the Hub.

Qualifications:

Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Developer, or Data Engineering role.
  • Power BI Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Power BI Desktop and Service. You should be highly proficient in DAX and Power Query (M).
  • Analytical Mindset: A knack for "finding the story" in the data and summarizing it for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Communication: Ability to explain "the story behind the numbers" to internal stakeholders and client operations.

Preferred Skills

  • Cloud Data Platforms: Experience working with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
  • CPG Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) KPIs, such as CSAT, Net Promoter Score (NPS), or supply chain/consumer sentiment data.
  • CX Experience: Background in Contact Center operations or Customer Experience design.

Core Competencies

  • Reliability: You take pride in the accuracy and consistency of "the daily numbers."
  • Agility: You can pivot quickly from routine reporting to building a new visualization for an urgent business request.
  • Self-Directed: You are comfortable managing a recurring reporting schedule with minimal oversight.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

job.title: Training and Quality Lead
job.description:
Company Description:

We are seeking an operational Training & Quality Lead from our BPO partner to ensure frontline agents deliver accurate, compliant, and effortless traveler experiences. Positioned within the partner's contact center operations, this role owns two connected outcomes: interactions consistently meet client quality standards, and agents are trained, certified, and coached to apply policies, processes, and knowledge resources correctly.

The ideal candidate combines contact center quality auditing and training delivery expertise, acting as the frontline bridge between vendor performance data, agent readiness, and client-side operations, product, and knowledge teams — closing the loop from defect detection to process fix to agent behavior change.

Job Description:

Quality Framework & Calibration

  • Operationalize and execute client-approved QA frameworks, evaluation forms, and scoring guidelines across voice, chat, and email channels.
  • Lead regular calibration sessions with client QA, BPO QA analysts, and team leads to maintain scoring consistency across sites.
  • Review policy, process, and Knowledge Base (KB) updates before release to confirm accuracy and agent usability.

Training Design & Agent Enablement

  • Design and deliver onboarding, nesting, upskill, and refresher training for new hires, tenured agents, and team leads.
  • Translate policy, process, and KB updates into change-management content: release notes, job aids, quick-reference guides, and short refresher sessions delivered before go-live.
  • Build scenario-based roleplays, simulations, and assessments within nesting and onboarding curricula.
  • Run knowledge checks and certification assessments to confirm agent readiness before production.
  • Equip team leads and coaches with coaching guides tied to audit findings so that behavior gaps are corrected at the floor level.

Operational Auditing & Performance Monitoring

  • Conduct daily audits of live interactions to detect incorrect policy applications, process deviations, knowledge gaps, and journey drops.
  • Audit escalations and transfers to evaluate context handoff, CRM documentation accuracy, and handle times.
  • Audit agent use of KB articles and tools, distinguishing process- or content-driven defects from agent-driven (skill or will) gaps.

Closed-Loop Feedback & Defect Analysis

  • Perform root-cause analysis on resolution failures, escalation spikes, and recurring customer friction points, classifying each as a process, knowledge, system, or training root cause.
  • Synthesize audit data into weekly reports; feed insights to client Operations, KB Managers, and Product teams for process and content improvements.
  • Convert agent-driven defects into targeted training interventions, coaching plans, and refresher content, and track post-intervention improvement.
  • Identify KB content gaps and recurring traveler queries, recommending new or updated articles.

Qualifications:

Experience

  • Contact Center Quality & Training Background: 3+ years in quality management, operational auditing, or training delivery within a high-volume BPO/contact center environment, with hands-on experience in both disciplines strongly preferred.
  • Training Design & Delivery: Proven experience building and facilitating onboarding, nesting, upskill, or refresher programs, including job aids, assessments, and roleplay scenarios.
  • Interaction Auditing: Demonstrated experience auditing voice, chat, or email interactions against defined quality standards and running calibration sessions.
  • Travel Industry (Preferred): Prior experience in travel, hospitality, or tech-enabled customer support operations is strongly preferred.
  • Methodology: Familiarity with process improvement tools (Lean, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis / 5 Whys) and instructional design models (ADDIE or similar); a train-the-trainer or facilitation certification is a plus.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Learning Design & Facilitation: Ability to turn audit findings and process changes into concise, engaging learning content and to facilitate confidently for agents, team leads, and leadership audiences.
  • Coaching & Calibration: Skilled in calibrating scoring across QA and operations teams and in coaching team leads to drive measurable behavior change.
  • Analytical & Data-Driven: Ability to turn transcript audits, CSS feedback, and performance dashboard data into actionable insights.
  • Change Management: Able to drive adoption of new policies, processes, and tools on the floor, anticipating agent resistance and readiness gaps.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Clear written and verbal reporting to present quality defects, training impact, and process feedback to BPO leadership and client teams.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Escalations Specialist - Snr Associate
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a motivated and passionate person to join us as an Escalations Specialist . We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Role Overview

As a Customer Escalation Specialist, you serve as the highest level of direct customer support and the final line of resolution for complex, high-friction, and escalated interactions, including high-value transactions and B2B large-scale orders. You will act as the ultimate brand ambassador, stepping in when standard procedures have been exhausted or when interactions become highly volatile. This role requires an elite combination of critical thinking, emotional intelligence, autonomous decision-making, and advanced technical troubleshooting to achieve single-contact ("one and done") resolutions, transforming dissatisfied customers into loyal brand advocates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complex Problem Solving & Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of highly complex, unresolved, and multi-contact customer issues passed down or escalated across multiple agents, particularly for high-value transactions and enterprise B2B bulk orders. Apply sharp critical thinking to thoroughly investigate long interaction histories, resolve operational bottlenecks, and achieve "one and done" complete resolutions without defaulting to further escalation or follow-up steps.
  • Customer Communication & Call Control: Strike an effective balance between deep empathy, active listening, strategic probing, and firm boundary setting. Maintain complete command of call flow and duration while steering volatile conversations toward productive resolution without overpromising or making unauthorized commitments.
  • Research & Resourcefulness: Conduct rigorous, independent research across internal knowledge bases, policy documentations, and tracking tools to ensure absolute accuracy before delivering definitive customer resolutions.
  • Judgment & Decision-Making: Exercise high-level business acumen and structured decision-making to balance immediate customer satisfaction, company policy guidelines, and long-term business impact. Issue refunds, credits, fee waivers, or complex policy exceptions autonomously within high authorized financial thresholds to safeguard high-value account relationships.
  • De-escalation & Retention: Apply structured de-escalation frameworks to manage high-friction, emotionally charged interactions, effectively neutralizing customer frustration while upholding brand integrity and professionalism.
  • Performance & Quality Metrics: Maintain high operational efficiency and composure during consecutive difficult calls, driving down Dissatisfaction (DSAT) metrics, maximizing Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), and minimizing post-call wrap-up times.

Candidates should possess the following qualifications and experience:

1. Specialized Role Experience: Background as an Escalation Representative, Retention Specialist, Customer Care Tier 2/3, or SME.

  1. Financial Authority: Demonstrated experience issuing refunds, credits, waivers, or complex policy exceptions up to authorized thresholds without real-time supervisor sign-off.
  2. Language & Accent: High level of English proficiency (B2 equivalent) with neutral accent adaptability for North American clients.
  3. Emotional Resilience: Ability to modulate tone under pressure, maintaining composure and professionalism during high-conflict or abusive calls. High intrinsic motivation and emotional stamina for resolving persistent, high-conflict customer friction daily. Ability to remain completely calm, empathetic, and objective under intense pressure.
  4. De-escalation Frameworks: Expertise in using structured communication frameworks during aggressive customer interactions.
  5. Problem-Solving & System Navigation: Capability to look beyond emotional language to identify root causes, navigate multiple backend systems simultaneously, and deliver definitive resolutions.
  6. Boundary Setting: Ability to set firm, polite boundaries, control call duration, maintain high CSAT, and effectively handle demands for management escalations.
  7. Stamina & Efficiency: Proven ability to manage back-to-back difficult calls while maintaining low DSAT scores and minimal post-call processing delays.
  8. Analytical & Root-Cause Thinking: Leverage strong diagnostic aptitude and analytical critical thinking to cut through emotional static, synthesize facts from disparate backend systems, pinpoint systemic or operational root causes, and systematically solve complex friction entirely on the first contact.
  9. Sound Decision-Making & Resourcefulness: Exceptional balance of independent research skills and critical decision-making, ensuring accurate, equitable resolutions that protect both the customer relationship and corporate interests.

Job Description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Bilingual Credit Analyst (B2) with experience in credit operations, loan origination, underwriting, and credit risk to support one of our growing banking/credit clients. This role combines credit process knowledge with B2B account support, operational issue resolution, and ongoing client communication.

The successful candidate will manage multiple client accounts, investigate credit-related operational issues, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver accurate and timely resolutions that meet client expectations.

If based in Bogota, this position is remote - if Barranquilla, it will be onsite.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support clients across credit operations, including loan origination, underwriting workflows, credit decisioning, credit risk processes, and collections.
  • Manage a portfolio of B2B client accounts, balancing competing priorities and maintaining consistent follow-up on open issues.
  • Investigate operational incidents, document findings, and coordinate escalations with engineering and other internal teams.
  • Track support tickets through resolution using Jira or similar tools, providing clear updates on progress and outstanding actions.
  • Support issues involving credit reporting agency integrations, APIs, and system configurations.
  • Review system logs and interpret basic technical information to assist with troubleshooting.
  • Participate in regular meetings with client subject matter experts to review issues, clarify requirements, and align on priorities.
  • Maintain accurate records and resolution reports, ensuring service delivery meets agreed standards and client expectations.
  • Communicate with clients in English and coordinate with internal teams in Spanish.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • At least two years of experience in credit operations, lending support, or a related financial services role.
  • Experience in loan origination, underwriting, and credit risk, with a solid understanding of credit processes and decisioning workflows.
  • Experience supporting B2B clients and managing multiple accounts or concurrent operational cases.
  • Ability to investigate issues, manage escalations, and follow through on resolution.
  • Experience with Jira or similar ticketing platforms.
  • Functional understanding of APIs and system integrations.
  • Ability to read system logs and understand basic scripting or coding logic.
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above, both written and spoken.
  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with close attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with credit reporting agency integrations and collections processes.
  • Familiarity with Postman, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), and system configuration logs.
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams to resolve client issues.

job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and technical person to join us as Senior Oracle Applications Developer - Finance & Accounting who will play a key role in driving our continued product growth and innovation. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!!

Job Description:

In this role, you will get to:

This is a senior level position where you are expected to own and drive your assignments through all stages (business requirements, technical definition, development, testing, UAT, production support) to completion with high level of quality and within project timelines.

This position requires implementing new oracle application modules with the assistance of external consulting resources as well as supporting existing application modules currently in use. Senior level development experience with Oracle’s development toolset is required as well as advanced troubleshooting skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develops new programs or makes changes to existing programs, according to business requirements. This will be in the areas of, but not limited to: Reports, Interfaces, Customizations, Extensions, and Workflow.
  • Leads requirement gathering meetings with business users. Assists business users with deciding on system configuration and setup of new and existing modules.
  • Works with all of Oracle’s development tools to resolve issues and build custom applications. Performs design and development of custom solutions for gaps identified by business users.
  • Prepares test environments for business use after cloning activity. Works with Oracle support staff and business users to develop resolutions for application issues.
  • Investigates use of Application modules not in use as well as study Application modules in use.
  • Level 2 production support by troubleshooting issues and working rapidly to provide a workaround or resolution to the stated issue and End user Support can include using sqlldr to refresh tables for business reporting or for projects.
  • Works with key business owners to support and troubleshoot production system issues.
  • Monitors system health by evaluating system self-monitoring script emails. Assists with system maintenance tasks and Other relevant tasks or duties may be assigned.
  • Participates in other departmental tasks when needed or required. Is in tune with and follows Oracle’s technology path and gets trained on new technology that Oracle is incorporating into the e-business suite.
  • Provide technical support to other IT developers including systems that interface with the Oracle Applications.
  • Follows and supports overall policies and goals for the companies Information Technology, including maintaining established Sarbanes Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory IT general controls over the production environment.

Qualifications

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • 8–12 years of experience working with Oracle E-Business Suite (11i/R12), with strong expertise primarily in Finance and Accounting modules.
  • 7+ years of experience with SQL and PL/SQL and SQL tuning including SQL and PL/SQL development tools
  • 5+ years of experience with Oracle Forms and Oracle Reports
  • 5+ years of experience with XML/BI publisher
  • 5+ years of experience with Oracle Workflow Builder
  • 2+ years of experience with Oracle Application Framework (OAF) desirable
  • 2+ years of experience with a Unix flavor operating system.
  • Knowledge of general business operating principles.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to multitask and maintain composure when working with the business users.

Required Skills

  • Strong professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work with little supervision and within changing priorities.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and troubleshoot problems.
  • Strong business acumen and deep understanding of business processes
  • Strong presentation, and conflict management skills
  • Experience mentoring and reviewing the work of functional team members.
  • Ability to work in a matrix team environment with both internal and 3rd party development teams (onshore / offshore).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Hybrid work model: In-office on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
  • Working Time: 2:30 PM IST to 11:30 PM IST
  • Work Location: Pune

Job Description:

Role Overview
The Architect / Manager will lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable data solutions across cloud and Snowflake environments. This role requires strong technical depth, leadership capability, and the ability to guide cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. The Architect will drive architectural standards, ensure best practices, and mentor engineers while collaborating closely with stakeholders across regions.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor data engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions in an Agile setup.
  • Define, design, and govern scalable, maintainable cloud data architectures.
  • Oversee solution design for Snowflake, orchestration platforms, and integration layers.
  • Provide technical leadership on Python automation, data pipelines, and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, etc.).
  • Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering leads to align on requirements and implementation plans.
  • Establish coding standards, review processes, and best practices for data quality, governance, and DevOps.
  • Support adoption of new technologies and drive continuous improvement within the team.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Proven leadership experience managing Agile teams and cross-functional data initiatives. 6+ years minimum direct or indirect management experience leading developers.
  • 10+ Years of experience with relational databases, preferably a combination of traditional databases and cloud-based platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and implementation.
  • Strong architectural expertise in cloud-based data platforms, especially Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, integration, and orchestration workflows.
  • Experience designing end-to-end data solutions with focus on scalability and maintainability.
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster.
  • Excellent oral and written communication. Ability to engage functional partners directly, when needed.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with dbt Labs or comparable tools.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Snowflake data models.
  • Interest or background in AI, machine learning, or data science.
  • Exposure to enterprise DevOps practices, CI/CD, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with Good Practice (GxP) Software validation.
  • Experience handling sensitive data, including Protected Health Information (PHI).

Attitude Requirements

  • Ownership-driven mindset and ability to lead by example.
  • Ability to manage both overperformers and underperformers.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity.
  • Adaptable to evolving technologies and business needs.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive and Solution-minded.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive key business metrics, including productivity, quality, service levels, customer satisfaction, and financial goals.
  • Monitor team performance and provide regular coaching, feedback, and development plans.
  • Manage employee engagement, attendance, attrition, and shrinkage to maintain a high-performing workforce.

  • Analyze operational data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities and implement action plans.
  • Build strong partnerships with clients and internal stakeholders to drive operational success.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Working knowledge of mortgage products and compliance standards, including:
  • FHA
  • VA
  • Fannie Mae
  • Freddie Mac
  • QM and Non-QM products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing large teams supporting U.S. mortgage operations.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
  • Demonstrated success in process improvement, operational excellence, and risk management initiatives.
  • Six Sigma, Lean, or other continuous improvement certifications are an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • People Leadership
  • Mortgage Origination
  • Performance Management
  • Client Relationship Management
  • Workforce Management
  • Process Improvement
  • Risk & Compliance Management
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Customer Experience Management
  • Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Work Arrangement

  • This role is primarily based onsite in Clark, Pampanga during the program launch and stabilization phase.

  • Work arrangement remains subject to business needs, client requirements, and company policies.

Job Description:

The Office of the CEO Escalation Agent is the trusted owner of client’s most sensitive, complex, and high-visibility customer escalations. You will resolve high-risk customer issues end-to-end, communicate with empathy and precision, and turn recurring pain points into operational and product improvements.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Care, Operations, Product, and High level management. It requires exceptional judgment, ownership, and the ability to create clear, executive-ready narratives under time pressure. Office of the CEO function focuses on resolving complex customer issues and improving the systems behind them, using escalation signals and customer sentiment to drive systemic change.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of escalated cases involving customer-impacting technical, billing, domain, hosting, security, or service issues.
  • Investigate root causes, coordinate across internal teams and vendors, and drive cases to a fair, timely, and durable resolution.
  • Serve as a calm, credible point of contact for customers during high-severity or reputationally sensitive situations.
  • Translate complex technical and operational details into concise, action-oriented updates for customers, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Trust & Safety, and Customer Care to remove blockers and prevent repeat escalations.
  • Identify systemic escalation drivers and recommend process changes, knowledge-base updates, coaching opportunities, or product fixes.
  • Maintain meticulous case documentation, including timelines, decisions, customer commitments, and closure rationale.
  • Provide structured status updates and leadership-facing summaries that support timely decision-making.
  • Coach and align internal and vendor teams on escalation quality, investigation depth, tone, and customer communication.
  • Support continuous improvement of intake, routing, case hygiene, and escalation playbooks to reduce misroutes and rework.

Qualifications:

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, escalations, technical support, customer success, operations, or a comparable customer-facing role.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, sensitive, or high-pressure customer cases from intake through resolution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages for customers, frontline teams, and executives.
  • Experience investigating issues, synthesizing information, and making sound decisions with incomplete information.
  • Comfortable working across time zones and partnering with global teams, customers, and BPO partners.
  • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and disciplined case documentation.
  • Proficiency with CRM, ticketing, and collaboration tools such as Salesforce, Slack, or similar platforms.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in domains, web hosting, websites, ecommerce, security, payments, or SaaS customer support.
  • Familiarity with GoDaddy products and services, including domains, hosting, Microsoft 365, websites, and security offerings.
  • Experience supporting executive escalations, social-media-sensitive cases, regulatory concerns, or high-risk customer situations.
  • Background in quality assurance, root-cause analysis, process improvement, or customer-experience operations will be helpful.
  • Ability to interpret escalation data and identify trends that warrant systemic fixes.

Additional Information:

Core competencies

Competency - What it means in this role
Ownership - Takes a case from ambiguity to resolution without dropping the customer or losing momentum.
Judgment - Knows when to act independently, when to escalate, and how to balance customer advocacy with business risk.
Communication - Writes clearly, speaks confidently, and delivers difficult updates with empathy and precision.
Cross-functional influence - Aligns technical, operational, legal, and product teams around a shared resolution path.
Problem solving - Looks beyond the immediate symptom to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.
Resilience - Remains composed and effective during urgent, emotionally charged, or high-visibility situations.

Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

SCOPE OF WORK FOR LIVE UNDERWRITER ROLE

• Loan Application Review & Credit Assessment:

Review and analyze loan applications and supporting documentation including income, credit reports, employment history, and property details. Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 C's methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions.

• Income Calculation & Financial Analysis:

Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately.

• Collateral & Property Evaluation:

Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details.

• Underwriting Decision & Documentation:

Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on risk assessment.

• Condition Management & Borrower Follow-up:

Issue clear and comprehensive condition requests to borrowers and processors. Track condition fulfillment, verify document receipt, and manage timelines to ensure expedited loan progression toward clear-to-close status.

• Workflow Management & Communication:

Collaborate with processors and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status. Escalate complex issues to senior management when necessary.

• Risk Identification & Compliance:

Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements including Fair Lending, TRID, and other applicable regulations.

• Quality Assurance & File Review:

Conduct thorough quality reviews of underwritten files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to company standards. Identify opportunities for process improvement and best practice implementation.

• Reporting & Reconciliation:

Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress and turnaround times. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide metrics to management.

• System Utilization & Process Adherence:

Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards. Maintain organized file documentation and audit trails.

• Exception Handling & Complex Case Management:

Manage non-standard loan scenarios, unusual financial situations, and exception cases requiring enhanced analysis. Develop creative solutions while maintaining regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.

• Training & Knowledge Sharing:

As a senior-level associate, mentor junior underwriting staff and processors on best practices, policy updates, and complex underwriting scenarios. Contribute to team development and process documentation.

• Performance Metrics & KPI Tracking:

Monitor individual and team performance against established benchmarks including loan turnaround times, accuracy rates, and productivity metrics. Analyze performance data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Regulatory Updates & Compliance Training:

Stay current with evolving lending regulations, compliance requirements, and industry updates. Participate in ongoing training and communicate regulatory changes to team members to ensure organizational compliance.

• Stakeholder Coordination & Escalation Management:

Coordinate with loan officers, real estate agents, appraisers, and other external stakeholders to facilitate smooth loan processing. Manage escalations and resolve conflicts professionally while maintaining positive client relationships.

JOB DETAILS

Company: Sutherland

Location: Navi Mumbai (Work From Home)

Experience: 2–3 Years (Live Underwriting Mandatory)

Shift: US Shift (6:30 PM – 6:30 AM | Any 9 Hours)

Week Offs: Rotational Weekly Offs

Employment Type: Full-Time

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Qualifications:

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • HSC and Bachelor's Degree (Mandatory)
  • Strong understanding of 4 C's of Credit
  • Expertise in income calculation (including self-employed borrowers)
  • Experience with LOS systems (Encompass preferred)
  • Good analytical and decision-making skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Demonstrated experience in customer relationship management and account servicing
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
  • Knowledge of lending regulations and compliance requirements
  • Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to client needs

Sutherland is a global leader in Customer Experience Management, with more than 60,000 employees worldwide. We partner with leading international brands to deliver outstanding customer experiences through innovation, technology, and talented people.

We are looking for motivated German-speaking Phone Sales Specialists to join our team and work with one of Europe's leading telecommunications providers.

In this role, you will combine inbound sales with customer support, helping customers find the right solutions for their internet, telephone, and TV needs.

Your responsibilities:

  • Advise customers over the phone and recommend suitable products and services through inbound calls.

  • Build positive customer relationships while identifying opportunities to increase sales and customer satisfaction.

  • German language proficiency at C1 level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • An interest in phone sales and customer-oriented communication.
  • A motivated, proactive, and results-driven attitude.
  • Willingness to learn and achieve sales targets.
  • Previous sales or BPO experience is an advantage but is not mandatory.
  • Willingness to work on-site at our office in Sofia, Bulgaria.

Additional Information:

What we offer:

  • Average total earnings of approximately €3,000 gross per month, including sales bonuses.
  • Monthly gross base salary of approximately €1,600.
  • Unlimited commission potential, plus additional quality and PBI bonuses.

  • Permanent employment contract and paid training.
  • Full-time training for approximately two months, including training and nesting.

  • Access to digital learning platforms, professional development, and clear career progression opportunities.
  • A modern office in Sofia with relaxation areas, a canteen, and modern facilities.
  • Meal vouchers, team events, and employee recognition programs.

The role starts with approximately two months of on-site training and nesting at our Sofia office. After this period, you will initially continue working from the office.

Not living in Sofia? We are happy to support you with your relocation to Sofia!

Company Description:

  • Sutherland is seeking to fill a Senior High Yield Credit Analyst. As a part of the Credit Research Team, you will work with a group of investment professionals to maximize the risk/return potential of high yield investments while also collaborating with the larger Credit Research team.
  • The Senior Analyst will be responsible for the credit coverage of a few major sectors and multiple individual company positions. Research delivery will include supporting primary and secondary trades while maintaining portfolio coverage on existing exposures.
  • The candidate is required to have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as High Yield Bonds, and Leveraged Loans.
  • The candidate should have prior experience towards supporting on primary and secondary deals by developing extensive financial models with multiple forecast scenario workouts and drafting of Investment Memo in an efficient and time-bound manner, together with excellent written & verbal communication skills to interact with onsite analysts and portfolio managers; which are some prerequisites for the role.
  • The team works as the virtual front-end analysts for clients, helping them find value in potential investment opportunities and thereafter, monitor the investment's performance.

Job Description:

  • Monitor single name corporate credit situations in North America across performing and opportunistic strategy in both leveraged loan and high yield markets
  • Perform investment research, including:
  • Building financial models with KPI driven Revenue models, Cost drivers, Working capital analysis, Capex schedule, Capital Structure forecast, Covenant analysis, Default & Recovery workouts and IRR sensitivities;
  • Term Sheet preparation from credit agreements and bond indentures
  • Drafting Investment Memos including identification of investment catalysts and provide recommendations on high yield bonds/loans, including fundamental and relative value views for primary and secondary trades
  • Presenting the primary/secondary deals to the investment committee. Have full-ownership of the deal and monitoring its constant performance against benchmark bonds.
  • Maintain portfolio coverage including model updates and earning summary write-ups, while maintaining regular news on the portfolio

Qualifications:

To succeed in this position, you must have:

  • MBA or equivalent in Finance /CFA/CA
  • Minimum of 4-5 years of buy-side or sell-side experience covering single name corporate credit in high yield markets, across Leveraged Loans and/or Bonds asset classes
  • Proficiency in building extensive financials models with 3-statement forecast (all interlinked) and developing base and downside cases
  • Experience in writing Investment Memos covering primary and secondary trades
  • Generalist with good sector exposure in any of TMT, Healthcare, Autos, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas sectors
  • Proficiency in using Databases & Portfolio Asset Management Systems- Bloomberg, CapIQ, FactSet, Syndication sites, Everest, eFront
  • Ability to work under pressure and deliver high-quality research in a timely manner

Job Description:

The Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) Specialist is responsible for leading occupational health and preventive medicine initiatives while supporting the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Occupational Health and Safety Management System (SG-SST), in compliance with Colombian regulations and company policies.

With a strong focus on employee health, this role manages health surveillance programs, medical case follow-up, medical absenteeism monitoring, and interventions aimed at preventing illness, reducing health-related risks, and supporting employees’ ability to work safely.

The OHS Specialist partners closely with Operations, HR, Facilities, medical providers, EPS, and ARL to address employee health needs and promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment within a fast-paced Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead preventive medicine and occupational health initiatives focused on early detection, disease prevention, and employee wellbeing.
  • Coordinate health surveillance programs (PVE), occupational medical evaluations, and follow-up on medical recommendations.
  • Manage medical case follow-up, absenteeism monitoring, medical restrictions, workplace accommodations, and return-to-work plans in coordination with HR, EPS, ARL, and medical providers.
  • Implement programs addressing musculoskeletal, ergonomic, cardiovascular, visual, and psychosocial risks.
  • Analyze health and absenteeism indicators to identify trends, prioritize interventions, and evaluate program effectiveness.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the SG-SST, ensuring compliance with Colombian regulations and company standards.
  • Conduct workplace assessments, support incident investigations and audits, and monitor corrective and preventive actions.
  • Deliver health promotion campaigns and OHS training, and support emergency preparedness activities.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Occupational Health & Safety.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a health-related field (e.g., Nursing, Physiotherapy, or Occupational Therapy).
  • Valid Colombian Occupational Health & Safety license.
  • Current SG-SST certification (50-hour course and applicable updates).
  • Active RETHUS registration.
  • Experience in preventive medicine follow-up, medical case management, and monitoring medical absenteeism.
  • B1 High or above English proficiency.

Desirable

  • Experience in BPO, Contact Center, Shared Services, or high-volume service environments.
  • Handling data analytics tools, such as Power-BI.
  • Experience managing programs related to psychosocial risk, absenteeism, ergonomics, and employee wellbeing.

Key Competencies

  • Occupational Health & Safety expertise
  • Knowledge of Colombian labor and OHS regulations
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Data analysis and KPI management
  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Project management

job.title: Lead Databricks Architect – Financial Services & Banking
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland:

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking an experienced Lead Databricks Architect with deep domain expertise in the banking and financial services industry to drive the strategy, design, and implementation of our enterprise lakehouse platform.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex banking business requirements and cutting-edge data architecture. You will be responsible for building a secure, scalable, and highly performant Databricks lakehouse environment that powers critical banking applications, including regulatory reporting, risk management, fraud detection, customer analytics, and real-time transaction processing.

Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Design and implement an enterprise-grade Databricks Lakehouse architecture leveraging Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks SQL tailored for financial data models.
  • Establish architectural patterns for high-throughput batch and real-time streaming data pipelines (e.g., Structured Streaming, Auto Loader) integrating core banking systems, payment gateways, and third-party data providers.
  • Drive the migration strategy from legacy data warehouses (e.g., Teradata, Oracle, Snowflake, mainframe environments) to Databricks.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Implement strict data security, enterprise access controls, and fine-grained permissions using Databricks Unity Catalog to comply with financial regulations (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PCI-DSS).
  • Architect data masking, tokenization, and encryption strategies for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data (SPD).
  • Ensure full data lineage, auditing, and metadata management across multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud deployment environments (Azure).

Data Engineering & Performance Optimization

  • Define best practices for PySpark, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and SQL optimization to maximize compute efficiency and reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Establish CI/CD, DevOps, and MLOps automation frameworks for code deployment, data quality validation (e.g., Great Expectations), and model lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Data Science, Quantitative Analytics, and BI teams to support advanced financial modeling, predictive risk analysis, and customer 360 initiatives.

Stakeholder & Domain Leadership

  • Collaborate with business leaders, Chief Risk Officers (CROs), and compliance teams to align data platform capabilities with core banking business objectives.

Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architecture governance to data engineering and analytics teams.

Qualifications:

Required Technical Skills

  • Databricks Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and running large-scale Databricks environments in production.
  • Cloud Architecture: Deep knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP data services (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage/Data Factory, AWS S3/Glue, or GCP GCS/BigQuery).
  • Data Processing & Storage: Mastery of Delta Lake, PySpark, Databricks SQL, Structured Streaming, and Delta Live Tables.
  • Governance & Security: Strong hands-on experience configuring Databricks Unity Catalog, RBAC, ABAC, and data governance frameworks.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins), and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs).

Required Banking Domain Knowledge

  • Domain Experience: 3+ years working within a retail bank, investment bank, or financial services institution.
  • Financial Data Models: Familiarity with core banking operations, payments, lending, credit risk, anti-money laundering (AML), or fraud data structures.
  • Regulatory Landscape: Strong understanding of banking data compliance requirements, auditability, and data sovereignty standards.

Education & Certifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Certifications (Preferred):
    Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
    Cloud Solutions Architect Certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At times, government agencies require periodic reports from employers on the sex, ethnicity, handicap, veteran and other protected status of employees. job.title: Senior IT help desk
job.description:
Job Description:

We're looking for a Senior IT Help Desk professional to join our organization in Cairo, Egypt. In this role, you will serve as a technical expert and trusted advisor to our end-users, providing comprehensive IT support and solutions. As a Senior IT Help Desk specialist, you will be responsible for resolving complex technical issues, mentoring junior support staff, and ensuring exceptional customer service while maintaining a detail-oriented and organized approach to all tasks.

  • Provide first and second-level technical support to end-users via phone, email, and remote access tools, resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues efficiently
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex IT problems using analytical skills and systematic approaches to identify root causes
  • Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware, software applications, and peripheral devices

  • Document all support tickets accurately and completely, maintaining organized records for tracking and follow-up
  • Respond to support requests in a timely manner, prioritizing issues based on business impact and urgency
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to junior help desk staff, sharing knowledge and best practices
  • Perform preventive maintenance and system updates to minimize downtime and optimize performance
  • Collaborate with other IT departments to escalate and resolve complex technical issues
  • Maintain a customer-focused approach by communicating technical information in clear, understandable terms

Qualifications:

Main Requirements – IT Help Desk Specialist - GTI

*shifts are rotational*

1- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communications Engineering, or an equivalent field.

2- 3+ years of hands-on experience in Windows environments and Cisco networking.

3- Strong knowledge of Windows troubleshooting, Active Directory, LAN, TCP/IP, switching, and routing.

4- Experience with hardware/software troubleshooting, user access management, and IT support.

5- Knowledge of virtualization, SCCM, VoIP/IP, and antivirus solutions.

6- Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance, and escalation procedures.

7- Flexibility to work rotational shifts, participate in on-call support, and work across different sites when required.

We are seeking for an Implementation Engineer with 5-10 years of experience to join our Delivery and Engineering team as NTR-x Professional Services Engineers (PSE). The role is responsible for the remote installation, implementation, configuration, and integration of the NiCE NTR-x platform, and for delivering enterprise-scale recording and compliance solutions to leading banks and financial institutions. The PSE provides technical expertise across the full project lifecycle, from the sales-to-services transition through project closure, working with Architects, Project Managers, R&D, Customer Support, and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, integrate, and configure the NiCE NTR-x recording solution remotely, following defined methodology, enterprise standards, system requirements, and customer-specific needs.
  • Develop and configure software features in line with design specifications and customer requirements; ensure all components of the technical architecture are properly integrated and implemented.
  • Plan and execute unit, functional, and system testing; support client UAT, data validation, and solution verification activities.
  • Assist customers and their vendors with configuration requirements for all NiCE integration points in the customer environment.
  • Provide technical expertise across the NiCE product suite (solution design, technical support, quality assurance, and application overview) throughout every project stage.
  • Report and escalate implementation issues appropriately; engage Support, R&D, and management for higher-tier assistance when required.
  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with customers and management on progress, risks, and technical updates.
  • Support after-hours, weekend, client-site, and cross-time-zone activities as required by project demands.
  • Communicate customer technical feedback to R&D and Product Support to drive product enhancements and fixes.

Qualifications:

Mandatory Skills/Experience:

  • Experience in the Financial Services / Banking domain.
  • Hands-on experience with NiCE or other recording solutions (e.g., Verint): installation, configuration, upgrades, and maintenance on Windows and cloud platforms.
  • Microsoft Windows Server / OS knowledge.
  • IP / SIP communication analysis and a strong telephony background.
  • Networking fundamentals: 7-layer OSI model, TCP, UDP, LAN/WAN, NICs, switches, and routers. Senior Professional Services Engineer (NTR-x)
  • Troubleshooting with sniffers and analysis tools such as Wireshark, log analysis, and other network-testing utilities.
  • Basic scripting: query and update knowledge (SQL / shell).
  • Strong customer-facing skills: able to lead technical discussions, manage stakeholder engagement, and represent NiCE in client meetings.

Good to have:

  • Telephony & Integration: Recording / telephony integration experience with PBX, switch, and ACD vendors, including Avaya, Cisco, Microsoft Teams, and Amazon Connect.
  • Cloud & Virtualization: Cloud experience with AWS (primary) and Azure. • Virtualization on VMware and Citrix.
  • Advanced Solutions: MDC, LDAP, SSO, and ACD integrations. • Database migrations. • Disaster Recovery and High-Availability designs.
  • Microsoft Security: Active Directory, Domain Controllers, Group Policy, and DNS. • Security policies, hardening, and encryption. • Certificate Authority and EFS.

Added Advantage:

  • Certifications: MCP / MCSE, CCNA, VMware, Citrix, AWS, Azure.
  • ​​​​​​​Microsoft SQL Server (2012 and above): installation, configuration, administration, backup, recovery, and maintenance

Additional Information:

This is a hybrid position in Usaquén, Bogotá, Colombia (North Point, Torre Krystal Building: Cra 7 #156-10)

job.title: Instructional Designer (AI-Forward Curriculum Design & Development)
job.description:
Company Description:

Shape the Future of Learning at Sutherland

At Sutherland, we don't just deliver exceptional customer and business solutions, we create learning experiences that transform careers, empower teams, and drive business success. As a global leader in digital transformation and business process solutions, we are passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and developing world-class talent.

We're building our talent pipeline for an Instructional Designer who thrives on creativity, collaboration, and innovation. If you're passionate about turning complex concepts into engaging, impactful learning experiences and enjoy working with diverse stakeholders in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to connect with you.

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Instructional Designer to join our Learning Design and Experience (LDEx) team.

In this role, you will own the complete learning lifecycle, from analyzing training needs and designing curriculum to developing learning materials, facilitating train-the-trainer sessions, and evaluating training effectiveness. You will create engaging learning experiences across classroom, virtual, self-paced, and e-learning environments.

This is an AI-forward role, where you will leverage generative AI and other AI tools throughout the instructional design process to accelerate content analysis, curriculum design, content development, and revisions, while maintaining accountability for instructional quality, accuracy, and learner outcomes.

Beyond course development, you will help solve business and performance challenges through innovative learning solutions that deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end learning solutions using instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE, SAM, and Bloom's Taxonomy.
  • Analyze business requirements, review content, and identify knowledge and performance gaps.
  • Develop curriculum maps, learning paths, lesson plans, facilitator guides, learner materials, job aids, assessments, and e-learning content.
  • Create learning solutions for instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, self-paced, and digital learning environments.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather information, validate content, and ensure accuracy.
  • Utilize AI tools to support content analysis, storyboarding, scripting, drafting, and content refinement while ensuring quality and compliance standards.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver learning projects on time and according to project requirements.
  • Conduct and support Train-the-Trainer (TTT) sessions to ensure successful implementation of learning programs.
  • Coordinate training readiness requirements, including tools, systems, technology, and learning materials needed before deployment.
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness using Kirkpatrick's Four Levels of Evaluation and recommend continuous improvements.
  • Lead learning initiatives that address organizational, operational, or performance challenges.
  • Manage multiple instructional design projects simultaneously while meeting quality and delivery expectations.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations (Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Lead Enterprise Strategy. Influence Decisions. Drive Business Performance.

At Sutherland, we are looking for a highly strategic and analytical leader to join our team as a Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations. This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for driving complex business initiatives, influencing executive decision-making, and delivering insights that shape organizational strategy and operational excellence.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders, you will identify growth opportunities, solve critical business challenges, evaluate strategic investments, and lead transformative initiatives across the organization. You will leverage data, business acumen, and structured problem solving to deliver meaningful outcomes that improve performance, efficiency, and long-term value creation.

This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, business transformation, or advanced analytics who thrive in fast-paced, highly visible environments.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

What You'll Do

Lead High-Impact Strategic Initiatives

  • Own and drive enterprise-level projects that address critical business priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to define objectives, develop execution plans, manage risks, and drive successful outcomes.
  • Evaluate strategic opportunities through business case development, scenario modeling, and financial analysis.

Shape Executive Decision-Making

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations and insights that influence key business decisions.
  • Serve as a thought partner to leaders on operational, financial, and strategic priorities.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Identify performance gaps, operational inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the business.
  • Recommend and support initiatives that optimize productivity, customer outcomes, and financial performance.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to monitor results and ensure sustainable impact.

Deliver Advanced Analytics & Business Insights

  • Build forecasting models, performance analyses, and strategic planning tools.
  • Design dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into key business drivers and organizational performance.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to support planning, budgeting, growth, and transformation initiatives.

Lead Ambiguous, Business-Critical Work

  • Tackle complex and time-sensitive business issues with limited direction.
  • Prioritize competing demands while maintaining focus on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Function as an independent strategic leader capable of influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen

  • You quickly understand business models, market dynamics, operational drivers, and financial performance indicators, enabling you to identify opportunities and solve high-value business problems.

Executive Presence & Communication

  • You can distill complex analyses into concise, compelling insights and effectively communicate with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Structured Problem Solving

  • You bring a consulting-style approach to addressing ambiguity, breaking down complex challenges, and developing practical recommendations.

Results Orientation

  • You operate with a strong sense of ownership, balancing strategic thinking with execution discipline to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an analytical discipline such as finance, economics, engineering, or mathematics.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Strategy, Operations, Management Consulting, Corporate Planning, Investment Banking, Business Transformation, Analytics, or related fields.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level strategic initiatives with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong financial, operational, and analytical modeling capabilities.
  • Advanced analytical and Excel modeling skills; SQL, Python, or R proficiency is a plus.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive audiences.

Additional Information:

Why Join Sutherland?

This is an opportunity to work directly on high-priority business challenges, influence strategic decisions, and create lasting impact across the organization. You'll partner with senior leaders, solve complex problems, and help shape the future direction of a global organization while advancing your career in a highly visible strategic role.

If you're passionate about combining strategy, analytics, and business leadership to drive meaningful results, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer (Manager Level | Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Transform Enterprise Data. Build the Future of Analytics.

Are you passionate about designing modern data platforms and solving complex analytics challenges at scale? We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to lead the evolution of our next-generation data ecosystem.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role for a seasoned data professional who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, and cloud modernization. You will play a critical role in transforming legacy reporting environments into scalable, high-performance cloud-based solutions while partnering with global stakeholders to deliver insights that drive business decisions.

If you enjoy owning end-to-end data solutions, optimizing enterprise reporting, and building robust data pipelines that empower analytics and AI-driven initiatives, this opportunity is for you.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

What You'll Do

Lead Enterprise Data Modernization Initiatives

  • Drive the migration of legacy reporting and analytics environments to modern cloud-based platforms.
  • Analyze existing BI models, SQL workloads, and reporting logic to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Convert complex business and reporting logic into scalable cloud-native data solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and seamless transition through comprehensive validation and testing.

Design & Build Scalable Data Platforms

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise-grade data pipelines and data products.
  • Build efficient data transformation frameworks using modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Optimize data models, processing frameworks, and reporting performance.
  • Establish scalable solutions that support future analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.

Partner with Business & Analytics Leaders

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on data architecture, reporting strategy, and platform capabilities.
  • Support strategic and ad hoc analytics requests through reliable, well-governed data assets.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Implement best practices for data governance, version control, documentation, and deployment.
  • Monitor platform performance and proactively identify optimization opportunities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across analytics and data engineering functions.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Data Platform Development.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced query development, optimization, and stored procedure logic.
  • Experience working with Power BI, semantic models, and DAX-based reporting environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, or similar big data technologies.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and analytics.
  • Experience using Git and modern software development practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, DLT Pipelines, and Unity Catalog.
  • Experience leading or contributing to cloud migration and data modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of modern data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and analytics platforms.
  • Databricks, Azure, AWS, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, customer-facing, or enterprise-scale operations.
  • Exposure to analytics, machine learning, or data science environments.

Additional Information:

Why Join Us?

Own High-Impact Data Initiatives

Take the lead on strategic data transformation projects that directly influence business performance and decision-making.

job.title: Platform Engineer & Cloud Ops Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable person to join us as Platform and Cloud Engineer will be responsible to bridges the gap between IT operations and cybersecurity, focusing on the continuous protection of infrastructure and data through automation, monitoring, and proactive defense.

Job Description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Architecture & Strategy (Senior-focused)

  • Lead the architecture and deployment of complex multi-cloud solutions (GCP/AWS), including networking, compute, storage, and multi-environment design.
  • Define platform standards and reusable patterns (e.g., Terraform modules, cluster blueprints).
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies to enhance cloud strategy and roadmap.
  • Drive cost optimization and FinOps practices, including right-sizing and governance.
  • Own platform reliability, scalability, capacity planning, and disaster recovery design.

Infrastructure Provisioning & Automation

  • Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
  • Write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation/ARM where applicable).
  • Maintain multi-environment infrastructure consistency (dev, staging, prod).
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks to reduce manual toil.

Kubernetes & Container Platform

  • Design, operate, and support production-grade Kubernetes clusters (GKE preferred).
  • Manage upgrades, autoscaling, node pools, namespaces, and RBAC policies.
  • Own Helm/Kustomize standards for application deployment.
  • Support or manage service mesh (Istio) for traffic management, mTLS, observability, and security.
  • Define and promote golden paths for safe and consistent app deployment.

CI/CD, Monitoring & Operational Support

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Monitor platform health using Datadog — metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, and alerts.
  • Troubleshoot issues, support incident response, and lead post-incident reviews (senior).
  • Maintain runbooks and dashboards; lead or support on-call rotations.

Leadership & Collaboration (Senior-focused)

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, set technical direction, and review designs.
  • Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional, and on/offshore teams.
  • Communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

TECH STACK

Required:

  • Cloud Platforms: GCP (Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Storage, IAM, Load Balancing), AWS (EC2, EKS, VPC, S3, IAM)
  • Kubernetes: GKE architecture, upgrades, Helm/Kustomize, autoscaling, RBAC
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (multi-environment, reusable modules, remote state)
  • CI/CD: GitLab pipeline development and support
  • Monitoring: Datadog (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs)
  • Service Mesh: Istio (traffic management, mTLS, observability)

Good to have:

  • GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Cloud FinOps tooling and cost optimization experience
  • Scripting languages (Python, Go, Bash)
  • Vault, Packer, service catalogs, and self-service platforms
  • Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

Qualifications:

REQUIREMENTS

Must have:

  • Platform Engineer: 3+ years in cloud infrastructure/platform or DevOps engineering.
  • Senior Platform Engineer: 8+ years, with leadership or architect-level responsibilities.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with GCP and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong Kubernetes production experience, preferably GKE.
  • Expert-level Terraform skills with reusable modules and multi-env IaC.
  • Proven CI/CD automation experience at scale.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex cloud environment issues.
  • Collaborative teamwork mindset with clear communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Certifications: Google Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
  • Experience with GitOps and progressive delivery techniques.
  • Prior FinOps or cloud cost optimization role experience.
  • Scripting for automation and Linux system administration background.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

  • Platform reliability: uptime and SLO achievement for shared services.
  • Automation coverage and manual toil reduction.
  • Adoption and enforcement of platform standards and self-service deployment paths.
  • Cloud cost efficiency achieved through optimization.
  • Timely and successful delivery of platform initiatives and projects.
  • Mean time to recovery (MTTR) for platform-impacting incidents.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Tech Lead - QA - Performance Testing
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland
Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

Role summary

We are looking for a Performance Engineer to design and execute performance testing across web applications, BI workloads, and ETL/data models in a SAFe environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Apache JMeter, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Playwright for custom web, BI, and ETL performance scripting. Azure DevOps pipeline experience is required. Ability to learn quickly is essential. Hands-on use of GitHub Copilot is needed; familiarity with MCP is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and analyze performance tests for web apps, BI reports/dashboards, and ETL/data models — JMeter (load, stress, soak, spike) for web, and custom Playwright/Python scripts for BI and ETL — and convert SLAs into measurable thresholds.
  • Validate ETL pipeline and data-model performance — job runtime, data volume handling, transformation throughput, and downstream reporting impact.
  • Assess BI performance — report/dashboard load times, query response, concurrent user load, and refresh/batch windows.
  • Integrate performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines with automated quality gates, reporting, and release readiness checks.
  • Identify bottlenecks, publish clear findings, and work with development, QA, data, and operations teams.
  • Participate in SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, Sprint Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt) and deliver against iteration/PI goals.
  • Use GitHub Copilot (and MCP where available) to accelerate scripting, analysis, and documentation.

Qualifications:

Required skills

  • 4–8 years in performance engineering or test automation with a strong performance focus.
  • Strong JMeter experience: test plans, correlation, parameterization, assertions, distributed execution, and result analysis.
  • Playwright + JavaScript/TypeScript and Python for custom client-side, BI, and ETL performance scripting.
  • Experience performance-testing web applications, BI tools, and ETL/data models.
  • Azure DevOps experience: pipelines, CI/CD, test execution, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe and ability to operate in Agile Release Trains.
  • Solid understanding of HTTP/APIs, data flows, and core performance metrics (latency, throughput, error rate, concurrency, job duration).
  • Practical experience with GitHub Copilot; familiarity with MCP is a plus.
  • Strong communication, root-cause analysis, and fast learning ability.

Nice to have

  • Deeper ETL / data pipeline background.
  • BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar.
  • k6, Grafana, Datadog, Application Insights, or other observability tools.
  • Cloud experience (Azure preferred).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
