job.title: Lead - SD Management
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is looking for a self-motivated, team-oriented and career-oriented person to join us as a Customer Support & Sales - Chat Consultant. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Position Purpose

Drives the daily operational performance and real-time execution of the helpdesk team. This role balances workforce monitoring, service level compliance, and active agent coaching to foster a high-performance service environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Queue & Service Level Management: Actively monitor real-time call queues, abandon rates, and ticket backlogs to dynamically shift resources and secure daily SLA targets.
  • Performance Coaching: Conduct structured weekly call monitoring audits and monthly performance feedback sessions for L1 and L2 agents to improve quality and FCR.
  • Operational Escalations: Act as the first formal escalation point for critical operational challenges, vendor disconnects, or highly dissatisfied employees.
  • Quality Assurance: Partner with the Quality Analyst to review team performance metrics, identify training gaps, and implement targeted remediation plans.
  • Team Engagement: Manage front-line team culture, driving initiatives to boost employee engagement, prevent burnout, and reduce team attrition.

Experience in Years

  • Total Experience: 5 to 7 years of professional experience in customer management/operations.
  • Domain-Specific Experience: Minimum 2 years of direct people management or supervisory experience leading a team within a voice-capable contact centre or an HR Shared Services hub.

Ideal Candidate Experience & Profile

  • People Developer: The ideal candidate is an inspiring front-line captain who has successfully managed groups of 10–15 agents, focusing heavily on operational metrics without losing sight of human morale.
  • Metric-Driven Floor Manager: They are hyper-aware of real-time dashboards. They know exactly when a spike in call volume requires altering break schedules or pulling an agent out of an offline task.
  • Constructive Coach: They have mastered the art of delivering direct, actionable performance feedback that motivates underperforming agents rather than discouraging them.
  • Process Fixer: They don't just patch problems; they proactively identify when a high volume of L1 transfers means the team needs an updated SOP or a refresher training session.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Operational Literacy: Solid understanding of contact center dynamics and core metrics (e.g., SLA, Occupancy, Shrinkage, CSAT, ASA).
  • Communication: Powerful interpersonal skills; able to deliver constructive, actionable feedback to team members and articulate operational issues clearly to management.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to make quick, data-driven decisions under pressure to resolve real-time staffing or queue bottlenecks.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

“Sutherland never requests payment or favors in exchange for job opportunities. Please report suspicious activity immediately to “TAHelpdesk@Sutherlandglobal.com”

Qualifications:

Graduation (preferably from HR stream)

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  • Experience selling complex infrastructure, cloud, security or managed-services engagements.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Oracle and/or Microsoft partner ecosystems.
  • Experience working effectively with offshore solutioning and delivery organizations.

Preferred Experience

Infrastructure Managed Services | Cloud Operations | Cybersecurity / Cyber Resilience | IT Resilience | SRE / AIOps | AI Infrastructure / AI Operations | Application Operations | Global SI / IT Services

  • CIO / CTO / CISO relationships personally developed.

A senior Infrastructure + Security business leader who can open the account, create the opportunity, shape the proposition and close strategic business.

job.title: Facilities Engineer (entry level) - Pili CamSur
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and attentive person to join us as a Facilities & Property Management Associate. We are a group of supportive and hardworking individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Facilities Operations & Maintenance

  • Manage day-to-day facilities operations including leasehold improvements, equipment upkeep, and site maintenance
  • Ensure functionality and readiness of all office equipment and physical workspace
  • Conduct regular facility inspections and implement preventive and corrective maintenance programs
  • Supervise contractors for general repairs, pest control, and scheduled maintenance activities
  • Oversee workspace readiness including seat assignments, relocations, and partition installations in coordination with Capacity Planning
  • Monitor utilities consumption (electricity and water) and maintain accurate tracking reports
  • Ensure Asset Maintenance Contracts (AMC) are updated and all equipment (UPS, AC units, gensets) are regularly serviced
  • Maintain organized documentation of service reports, contracts, and compliance records
  • Support implementation of health and safety standards across the site

Ticketing & Service Management

  • Manage and resolve facility-related requests via ticketing systems within agreed SLAs
  • Monitor ticket queues to avoid backlog and aging issues
  • Provide timely updates and coordinate approvals with stakeholders

Project & Site Management

  • Support project teams in site build-outs, renovations, and rehabilitation activities
  • Coordinate project schedules and maintenance work with internal departments to minimize disruption
  • Participate in weekly seat planning and operational meetings

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Respond to internal requests for office setup (meetings, training, onboarding sessions)
  • Collaborate with Capacity Planning for workspace and equipment requirements
  • Coordinate with building administration on facility concerns and maintenance issues
  • Liaise with vendors, lessors, and government agencies (e.g., PEZA, local authorities) to ensure compliance

Training & Development

  • Participate in continuous learning and development programs to enhance technical and operational competencies

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
  • Required: Licensed Mechanical or Electrical Engineer
  • Willingness to work extended hours or flexible schedules, as needed
  • Must be willing to report on-site at Sutherland Pili CamSur, IT Park, Provincial Capitol Complex, Cadlan, Pili, Camarines Sur, 4418
  • Knowledgeable in civil and structural building construction, including interior and exterior works
  • Proficient in designing and computing Electrical and Mechanical plans
  • Hands-on knowledge in the operation and maintenance of generator sets, UPS systems, and other critical facility equipment
  • Capable of evaluating vendor preventive maintenance reports and recommending appropriate action plans
  • Basic project management skills with experience supporting site build-outs, renovations, and maintenance projects
  • Familiarity with facilities operations, including utilities monitoring, equipment maintenance, and workplace management
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend improvements
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate in a clear, professional, and constructive manner
  • Demonstrates professionalism, confidentiality, and high ethical standards at all times
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Proactive team player with the ability to develop trust and collaborate effectively across teams
  • Highly adaptable and able to quickly adjust to changing priorities and work environments
  • Strong work ethic, integrity, flexibility, and leadership or coaching capabilities

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Department: Knowledge Management (KM)

You will play a key role in developing content strategies, coordinating content projects, and maintaining consistency across various digital platforms.

Responsibilities:

Content Leadership:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document their existing processes.

  • Implement and manage a content management system (CMS) to organize and categorize knowledge base content.

  • Collaborate with the KM team to ensure best practices are followed in knowledge base development and management.

Client Advisory & Engagement:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on knowledge management strategies and practices.
  • Offer insights and recommendations for improving KM processes.
  • Build strong relationships with clients to drive adoption of best practices.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client engagements related to process documentation and knowledge management.
  • Conduct regular meetings and presentations with clients to discuss project progress, findings, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet client needs and expectations.

Strategic Planning:

  • Team management capabilities and handling client facing calls, work on business review and create slides for business review.
  • Contribute to the development of strategic plans and initiatives related to knowledge management and process improvement.
  • Participate in strategic discussions and decision-making processes to align KM efforts with organizational goals and objectives.

Content Creation and Quality Assurance:

Qualifications:

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description:

About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
  • Effective in a fast-paced hybrid Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Builds durable working relationships across engineering, QA, operations, and client teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delivery experience in a BPO or outsourced contact center environment, with multi-client and multi-site deployments.
  • Experience delivering AI and automation into a contact center: virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent assist, speech and text analytics, or intelligent routing.
  • Experience delivering CCaaS capabilities in a multi-tenant, cloud-native environment.
  • Prior time inside contact center operations, such as a supervisor or workforce role, alongside technology delivery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CSPO, CSM, SAFe, or PMP, or a platform-specific contact center certification.

Job Description:

The Medical Coding Team Lead supports the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Department by serving as a resource to coding staff and partnering closely with Coding Managers to ensure operational efficiency, coding quality, productivity, and compliance. This position provides technical guidance, assists with workflow coordination, monitors work queues and performance metrics, resolves routine operational issues, and supports training and quality initiatives. The Team Lead serves as a liaison between coding staff and management, helping to maintain consistent operations while promoting a collaborative and high-performing work environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day operational support to Coding Managers without assuming direct supervisory responsibility; to include workflow coordination in alignment with operational priorities.
  • Monitor coding work queues, assign or redistribute workloads as directed, and escalate issues that may impact productivity or turnaround times.
  • Serve as resource for coders regarding routine coding questions, workflow concerns, and operational issues.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to coding staff while promoting coding accuracy and compliance.
  • Reinforce departmental policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Assist Coding Managers in monitoring coding productivity, quality, and turnaround time metrics.
  • Support employee development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and education.
  • Escalate employee performance concerns, workflow barriers, or compliance issues to Coding Managers as appropriate.
  • Assist with providing ongoing education related to departmental procedures.
  • Assist with ensuring compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational coding guidelines.
  • Support departmental projects, workflow improvements, system implementations, and process optimization initiatives.
  • Stay current with coding regulations, payer requirements, CMS guidance, and industry best practices.
  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive medical coding experience.
  • Previous experience serving as a senior coder, lead coder, trainer, mentor, or similar role preferred.
  • Current coding certification such as:
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)
  • Certified Outpatient Coder (COC)
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
  • or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred
  • Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding systems.
  • Thorough understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific requirements.
  • Experience using electronic health records (EHR) and coding software.

Job Description:

The Medical Coding Auditor is responsible for keeping Sutherland coders in compliance by reviewing medical records and coding practices to ensure accurate assignment of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II codes in compliance with federal, state, payer, and organizational guidelines. This role evaluates coding accuracy, identifies documentation deficiencies, conducts audits, provides education to coding staff and providers, and supports revenue cycle integrity while minimizing compliance risk.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform retrospective, concurrent, and prospective coding audits for inpatient, outpatient, physician, and/or specialty services.
  • Review medical documentation to validate the accuracy and completeness of assigned diagnosis and procedure codes.
  • Ensure compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Identify coding errors, documentation gaps, and reimbursement opportunities.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, trends, recommendations, and corrective actions.
  • Provide one-on-one and group education to coders, providers, and clinical staff regarding coding updates, documentation improvement, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor coding quality metrics and develop action plans to improve coding accuracy and consistency.
  • Stay current on coding regulations, Official Coding Guidelines, CMS regulations, payer policies, and industry best practices.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, payer reviews, and regulatory investigations.
  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Participate in policy development, process improvement initiatives, and coding education programs.
  • Track audit results and identify recurring trends to support continuous quality improvement.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of medical coding experience in a healthcare setting.
  • Minimum of 2 years of coding audit or quality review experience preferred.
  • Current coding certification such as:
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or
  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred
  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems.
  • Strong understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific policies.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) and encoder software.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare reimbursement methodologies.
  • Ability to interpret complex clinical documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain objectivity while providing constructive feedback.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and coding/audit software.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

A senior technology-services leader who can solve, win, build capability, govern delivery and convert delivery expertise into scalable IP.

Job Description:

The Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for analyzing, evaluating, and underwriting residential mortgage loan applications across Conventional and Non-Qualified Mortgage (Non-QM) programs, including Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) loans and alternative documentation products. This role ensures compliance with investor, agency, company, and regulatory guidelines while assessing borrower eligibility, mitigating lending risk, and supporting timely loan decisions. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to make sound underwriting decisions in a fast-paced mortgage lending environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and underwrite residential mortgage loan applications, including Conventional, Non-QM, and DSCR loan products.
  • Analyze borrower credit profiles, income, assets, employment history, financial stability, and collateral to determine loan eligibility and risk exposure.
  • Evaluate alternative documentation loan programs, including bank statement, asset depletion, ITIN, 1099, and P&L-only loans.
  • Calculate and assess Debt Service Coverage Ratios (DSCR) and perform complex income and risk analyses.
  • Ensure compliance with agency, investor, company, federal, and state lending guidelines, including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, ATR/QM, TRID, RESPA, TILA, HMDA, HOEPA, and other applicable regulations.
  • Perform manual underwriting when required and evaluate exception requests within established risk parameters.
  • Issue loan approvals, conditional approvals, suspensions, or denials based on underwriting guidelines and risk assessment.
  • Review loan documentation for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance, identifying discrepancies and potential risk factors.
  • Communicate underwriting requirements and decisions to loan officers, account executives, brokers, processors, and other stakeholders.
  • Review resubmitted conditions and documentation to ensure timely loan processing and closing.
  • Maintain accurate records of underwriting decisions and loan documentation.
  • Support internal audits, quality control reviews, and post-closing documentation requests.
  • Stay current on mortgage industry trends, investor requirements, agency guidelines, regulatory changes, and Non-QM product offerings.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, loan quality, and customer service levels.
  • Manage multiple loan files while meeting service level agreements and production deadlines.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field preferred; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum 2–5 years of mortgage underwriting experience, including Conventional and/or Non-QM loan products.
  • Strong knowledge of Conventional underwriting guidelines, including Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac requirements.
  • Experience underwriting Non-QM products, including DSCR and alternative documentation loans, preferred.
  • Thorough understanding of mortgage lending regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency with Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Automated Underwriting Systems (AUS), including DU and LP, and electronic document management systems.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to perform detailed income calculations, credit analysis, collateral review, and risk assessment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage a high-volume pipeline in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with wholesale, correspondent, or retail mortgage lending channels.
  • Familiarity with secondary market requirements and investor-specific guidelines.
  • Knowledge of quality control, audit processes, and post-closing reviews

Additional Information:

  • Working Conditions
  • Full-time position with 6 months of Work-from-Office (WFO), followed by a transition to Work-from-Home (WFH)
  • Requires management of multiple loan files and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Frequent collaboration with loan officers, processors, account executives, operations teams, auditors, and management.
  • Immediate joiner
  • US Rotational Night Shifts

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and leverage your skills in a rewarding role, we want to hear from you!

job.description:
Company Description:

At Sutherland we are a group of energetic and driven individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Role Summary:

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Mail Operations will serve as a technical and operational expert supporting email operations, spam/abuse mitigation, and Trust & Safety workflows. The role will be responsible for handling complex and escalated cases, providing subject matter guidance to analysts, monitoring emerging email abuse trends, and supporting operational excellence in a 24x7 environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert for email operations, spam, phishing, spoofing, abuse, and related Trust & Safety workflows.
  • Provide real-time guidance and support to analysts in handling complex, high-risk, and escalated email abuse cases.
  • Review complex cases and ensure decisions are aligned with defined policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Monitor trends related to spam, phishing, spoofing, malware, account abuse, and other forms of email-based threats, and identify emerging patterns.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective/preventive actions for operational and quality issues.
  • Conduct regular knowledge-sharing, coaching, calibration, and refresher sessions for analysts to improve process understanding and decision accuracy.
  • Support Team Leaders and Operations Managers with quality, productivity, SLA, and operational performance insights.
  • Leverage Splunk and other relevant tools to monitor operational trends, investigate incidents, track KPIs, and generate actionable insights.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, SMTP, email headers, and email infrastructure to support investigations and troubleshooting.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and workflow optimizations.
  • Support the development and maintenance of SOPs, process documentation, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in calibration sessions and quality reviews to drive consistency and accuracy across the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Trust & Safety, Security, Engineering, Product, Quality, and Operations, to resolve complex issues and improve workflows.
  • Support new-hire training, nesting, upskilling, and ongoing capability-building for the operations team.
  • Stay current on evolving email threats, abuse patterns, authentication standards, and industry best practices, and translate relevant insights into operational improvements.
  • Support 24x7 operations, including shift-based activities, escalations, and critical incident management as required.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in email operations, Trust & Safety, email security, SOC, cybersecurity operations, or a related domain.
  • Strong understanding of SMTP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, email headers, DNS, and email infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, including dashboard usage, log analysis, monitoring, and investigation.
  • Strong knowledge of spam, phishing, spoofing, malicious emails, email abuse, and threat vectors.
  • Demonstrated experience handling complex investigations, escalations, and incident analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns and determine appropriate actions.
  • Experience conducting RCA, trend analysis, quality reviews, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and provide real-time operational guidance in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working in a 24x7 operational setup is preferred.
  • Preferred Skills:
  • Experience in email security, cybersecurity, Trust & Safety, or abuse prevention.
  • Knowledge of SIEM tools, threat intelligence, log analysis, and security monitoring.
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, or data-analysis tools.
  • Experience working with large-scale email platforms or cloud-based email environments.
  • Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, email security, or cloud technologies would be an advantage.

Job Description:

Owns the end-to-end technical architecture across all workstreams. Acts as the single point of architectural authority ensuring solutions are consistent, secure, and scalable across AWS and Microsoft-based environments, and arbitrates trade-offs between teams working on parallel builds.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the target-state architecture spanning AWS (Bedrock, Fargate, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB, S3) and Azure (AI Foundry, Document Intelligence) environments.
  • Set integration standards for Microsoft Graph API/Teams-based delivery channels used across chatbot, translation, and document-processing services.

  • Evaluate integration options where core business systems restrict API access or screen scraping, and recommend viable architectural workarounds.
  • Represent technical architecture in governance forums and in scoping discussions for new builds.
  • Define non-functional requirements: security, data residency, exactly-once processing guarantees, and disaster recovery across a multi-site delivery model.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in enterprise/solution architecture, including 3+ years designing GenAI/agentic systems in production.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of AWS Bedrock, Bedrock Agent Core, Amazon Nova, Fargate, and event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS).
  • Experience architecting solutions that span two cloud providers (AWS + Azure) in a single environment.
  • Regulated industry background strongly preferred — understands the difference between "automatable" and activity that must remain human-owned.
  • Track record of standing up architecture governance under an aggressive delivery timeline.

job.title: Lead -Quality Assurance (Email Abuse)
job.description:
Company Description:

At Sutherland we are a group of energetic and driven individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Role Summary

A Quality Analyst – Email Abuse within the Trust & Safety team will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness of decisions made while identifying and addressing abusive, fraudulent, and malicious email activity.

The role involves conducting regular audits, identifying quality and policy gaps, supporting calibration sessions, performing root cause analysis, and providing actionable feedback to Operations and Training teams.

The Quality Analyst will work across email abuse scenarios such as spam, phishing, scams, malicious content, impersonation, spoofing, account compromise, and other forms of email-based abuse, ensuring decisions are aligned with client policies, SOPs, and applicable Trust & Safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audit Planning & Execution

  • Conduct Daily/Weekly/Monthly quality audits of Email Abuse cases based on defined sampling guidelines.
  • Ensure adequate coverage across different case types, risk levels, workflows, and escalation categories.
  • Perform audits on agent decisions to assess accuracy, policy adherence, investigation quality, and appropriate enforcement actions.
  • Conduct Live, Recorded, and Side-by-Side evaluations as required.
  • Ensure audit completion within defined QA SLAs.
  • Identify critical errors and immediately escalate high-risk or policy-sensitive cases.

2. Quality Assurance & Monitoring

  • Maintain adherence to defined sampling, audit, and agent-feedback SLAs.
  • Evaluate cases for correct identification and classification of email abuse.
  • Assess the accuracy of decisions involving:
  • Spam and unsolicited email
  • Phishing
  • Scams and fraudulent communications
  • Malicious or suspicious links
  • Impersonation and spoofing
  • Account compromise
  • Malicious attachments or content
  • Abuse of email services
  • Identify trends in quality defects, policy misses, investigation errors, and incorrect enforcement decisions.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or high-impact quality issues.
  • Recommend corrective action plans and targeted coaching for repeated performance gaps.
  • Track improvement following corrective actions.

3. Calibration & Consistency Management

  • Participate in regular calibration sessions with QA, Training, Operations, and SME teams.
  • Ensure consistent interpretation and application of Email Abuse policies.
  • Participate in client and cross-location calibration sessions where applicable.
  • Identify policy ambiguity and gray-area cases requiring clarification.
  • Document calibration outcomes and communicate changes to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support Gage R&R / Repeatability & Reproducibility exercises, where applicable, to assess consistency and reliability of quality evaluations.

4. Risk Mitigation & Compliance Management

  • Identify and escalate critical Email Abuse violations and high-risk cases.
  • Monitor for systemic failures that may result in increased exposure to phishing, scams, fraud, malicious activity, or platform abuse.
  • Partner with Trust & Safety Policy, Training, and Operations teams to identify gaps in SOP and policy interpretation.
  • Ensure appropriate escalation of cases requiring SME, Policy, or client review.
  • Support compliance with data privacy, information security, and client-specific requirements.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and risk logs for critical quality issues.

5. Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare and maintain regular QA reports covering:
  • Quality scores
  • Error trends
  • Policy adherence
  • Critical errors
  • Sampling coverage
  • Audit completion
  • RCA findings
  • Corrective actions
  • Translate quality findings into actionable recommendations for Training, Operations, and Policy teams.
  • Share recurring quality gaps and recommend refresher or targeted training.
  • Present quality trends and improvement opportunities during team reviews and governance meetings.
  • Work closely with Training and Operations to monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions.
  • Support WBRs, QBRs, client governance reviews, and other quality forums as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in any stream.
  • 1.5–3 years of experience in Quality Assurance, preferably within Trust & Safety, Email Abuse, Fraud Operations, Risk Operations, Content Moderation, or Policy Enforcement.
  • Experience conducting transaction/case-level audits and providing structured feedback.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics, sampling, audit methodology, and RCA.
  • Ability to interpret and apply policy consistently across complex and ambiguous cases.
  • Good understanding of Email Abuse concepts such as spam, phishing, scams, spoofing, impersonation, malicious links, and account compromise.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Operations, Training, Policy, and SME teams.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is preferred.

job.title: Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig
job.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung:

Über uns

Wir sind Sutherland, ein global führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Customer Experience Management (CXM) – mit über 37 Jahren Erfolgsgeschichte, mehr als 60 Standorten weltweit und seit 2017 auch im Herzen von Pristina vertreten.
Hier arbeiten über 500 Kolleginnen und Kollegen täglich daran, Service- und Verkaufserlebnisse auf höchstem Niveau zu schaffen – für renommierte Marken und Marktführer in Europa.

Unser Telekommunikationsprojekt für die Premium-Marke Europas ist eines der größten und erfolgreichsten in der Region.
Wir kombinieren exzellenten Kundenservice, moderne Technologien und verkaufsorientierte Beratung – alles mit dem Ziel, unseren Kunden das beste Erlebnis zu bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung:

DEINE ROLLE

⟢ Als Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist bist du die Stimme der bekanntesten Telekommunikationsmarke Europas.
⟢ Du hilfst Kunden nicht nur bei Fragen zu Internet, Telefonie und TV, sondern nutzt jede Gelegenheit, um bedarfsgerecht zu beraten und mit deinem Engagement Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Konkret heißt das:

⟢ Du bearbeitest Anfragen rund um Produkte und Dienstleistungen eines führenden Telekommunikationsanbieters

⟢ Du löst technische oder administrative Anliegen zuverlässig und freundlich

⟢ Du erkennst Verkaufschancen und präsentierst passende Angebote & Zusatzangebote

⟢ Du trägst aktiv zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Teamerfolg bei

Qualifikationen:

WAS DU MITBRINGST

✓ Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1)

✓ Freude am Kundenkontakt und am gemeinsamen Erfolg

✓ Eine kommunikative, lösungsorientierte und positive Art

✓ Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Herausforderungen anzunehmen

✓ Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenservice ist ein Plus – aber keine Pflicht

Zusätzliche Informationen:

WARUM SUTHERLAND?

🔗 Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Unternehmen

🔗 Leistungsorientierte Vergütung & attraktive Bonusmöglichkeiten

🔗 Moderne Büroräume im Zentrum von Pristina

🔗 Teamspirit & offene Kultur – hier zählt dein Beitrag wirklich

🔗 Coaching & Weiterentwicklung durch erfahrene Führungskräfte zertifizierte Coachs aus dem Ausland

🔗 Erfolgs- und Bonusaktionen, Wettbewerbe & Anerkennung für Leistung

💬 KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann warte nicht – gestalte deine Zukunft mit uns und werde Teil unserer Welt!
Bewirb dich jetzt und starte deine Karriere im Kundenservice & Vertrieb beim Telekomunikationsgiganten in Pristina.

job.title: Director - Research
job.description:
Company Description:

Account Management Lead – Research & Financial Markets

Sutherland’s Research & Financial Markets division drives high-impact transformation agenda to address our clients’ most complex business issues - from digital transformation and strategic cost management to operating model redesign, research enablement, analytics, automation, and managed service delivery.

Typical client segments include Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Private Equity firms, Pension Funds, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Sell-side Research firms, large Corporates, and other Financial Markets institutions.

Sutherland Research has made significant investments in building differentiated solutions that help Financial Institutions reimagine how research, analytics, investment operations, portfolio monitoring, reporting, data management, and decision-support functions are delivered. Our solutions combine domain expertise, global delivery capability, AI-enabled workflows, and operating discipline to help clients improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and insight generation.

Our teams help clients architect future-state operating models, enhance service operations, expand research and analytics capacity, and maximize value from Sutherland’s engagement.

Job Description:

Reporting to the Business Head for Financial Markets, key responsibilities include:

► Manage and grow a portfolio of named Financial Markets accounts across Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Pension Funds, and large Corporates
► Own account-level revenue targets, with responsibility for expansion, renewals, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within specified accounts
► Develop deep client relationships across Research, Strategy, Investment Operations, Data, Analytics, Finance, and CXO-level stakeholders
► Identify new opportunities within existing accounts by understanding client priorities, operating challenges, budget cycles, and transformation agendas
► Generate new leads through disciplined outreach, referrals, client mapping, industry research, thought leadership follow-up, and relationship-led prospecting
► Build account plans for key clients, including stakeholder maps, current engagement footprint, whitespace opportunities, competitor presence, and growth strategy
► Position Sutherland’s high-end professional services across Investment Research, Portfolio Monitoring, Market Research, ESG Research, Investment Reporting, Automation, & Analytics
► Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Solutioning, Research Leadership, and offshore subject matter experts to shape relevant client propositions
► Support proposal development, commercial discussions, pricing inputs, solution design, and contract renewal processes
► Deliver high-quality pitches and business reviews to senior stakeholders
► Maintain a disciplined account management cadence, including pipeline tracking, opportunity follow-up, CRM hygiene, revenue forecasting, and client touchpoint planning
► Ensure client satisfaction by proactively identifying service issues, escalation risks, delivery gaps, and opportunities to improve engagement quality
► Partner with delivery teams to ensure Sutherland is viewed as a strategic partner
► Support marketing and dissemination of thought leadership at various industry forums
► Travel as required for client meetings, account reviews, industry events, etc

Qualifications:

I. Candidate will possess strong account management and sales capabilities with a minimum of 6 - 10 years of progressive experience in account management, business development, enterprise sales, or client relationship management

II. Graduate degree required; Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred

III. Should possess strong understanding of Financial Markets, including Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Sell-side Research, Investment Operations, and Research & Analytics services

IV. Should have experience managing named accounts, developing account plans, identifying whitespace opportunities, and growing revenue within existing client relationships

V. Should be commercially astute, financially literate, and comfortable discussing research, analytics, data, reporting, and managed services with senior client stakeholders

VI. Experience selling or managing professional services, research services, offshoring, outsourcing, analytics, data management, or financial services solutions is highly desirable

VII. Should have a strong client service orientation with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across multiple stakeholder levels

VIII. Must possess strong sales discipline, including pipeline creation, opportunity qualification, revenue forecasting, proposal coordination, and follow-through

IX. Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders at Head of Function and CXO levels

X. Previous experience in a front-office, research, investment operations, consulting, or financial services environment will be an added advantage

job.title: AVP - CDE, Manufacturing
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is a digital transformation company focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both customers and employees. For 38 years, we have been entrusted with caring for our clients’ customers - a responsibility we believe we should earn every day. We are dedicated to making those experiences as delightful as possible - instantaneous, relevant, predictive, and frictionless. As an early pioneer in robotic automation, we added to our core through steady investment and acquiring key capabilities. Our design capabilities marry human insight, design- thinking, and process engineering. To make these designs come to life as envisioned by our designers, we employ the latest in robotic automation, conversational AI techniques with a range of AI-ML enhanced products and cloud-based platforms.

We believe that the best relationships come from trust and value. In addition to delivering exceptionally engineered experiences, we help our clients improve their productivity, reduce costs, enhance customer loyalty, build additional revenues, reduce time-to-market, and efficiently enter new markets. We also stand by our results. Sixty-one percent of our business is outcome based, ensuring our success is clearly tied to our clients’ success. We think that is simple for our clients to understand, and it adds to trust and transparency. Today, over 60 percent of our revenues come from clients with us for more than 11 years. Forty percent of our revenues come from Fortune-50, and 56 percent from Fortune-500 clients.

Though we have a rich history, our sights are anchored deeply in the future. We are optimistic about the benefits industry and society will see as human–machine collaboration continues to enhance what people can do. Our offerings deliver on this whether they are Sutherland Anywhere, enabling a secure remote work environment or Sutherland Connect, delivering data- rich, omni-channel services. Our deep product and platform expertise is trained on solving human problems before they emerge, and on how we wrap services around them - hiring, training, performance, security and more - to solve problems for our clients from end to end. We work with clients across industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, and Technology, as well as Travel, Hospitality and Logistics.

Our digital backbone spans 144 countries around the world, with 61 delivery centers across 19 countries, handling over 43 million transactions a month for approximately 70 clients. We are a team of 38,000 global professionals, operationally effective, culturally meshed, and committed to our clients and to one another. We call it One Sutherland.

Job Description:

The CDE is responsible for selling Sutherland offerings to new logo Manufacturing accounts where Sutherland presently has no relationships. The CDE drives new logo revenues through relationship development, quality delivery and execution of all engagement that drive organic growth and strong relationships.

An ideal CDE is passionate about developing and driving new client relationships and can successfully interact with senior executive level clients. This individual manages new revenue development and can lead complex multi-dimensional engagements that combine digital, consulting, and large technology deployments. This person is a high-energy leader with the ability to grow client relationships through presenting new strategies and innovative ideas.

Additional information

Key Result Areas (KRAs):

  • Profitable Growth - Accountability of total growth in the account including R&G accountability. Expand Digital penetration.
  • Executive Relationship Management - Nurturing existing relationships with the goal to keep / turn stakeholders into advocates, with increased focus on Expanding CXO relationships. Continued high NPS.
  • Proactive Value Creation, Innovation - Value creation and demonstration in existing engagements. Strategic Alignment with Client’s agenda and building executive cadence to continually discuss value.
  • Thought Leadership, Trusted Advisor - Be the Trusted Advisor your client calls for advice and ideas. Cross Industry sessions give our TIG thought leaders the stage in front of the clients.
  • Hands on Leadership - Ensuring contractual commitments are met. Proactively addressing issues that may arise in service delivery.
  • Champion transformation initiatives within the accounts

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of 5X of in year revenue target.

  • Identify opportunities to offer value through our new strategic services

Job Description:

The Senior Team Leader is responsible for leading multiple Content Protection Operations (CPro) teams, ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of copyright infringement and legal claims. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to consistently achieve Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defect (QD), Average Handling Time (AHT), productivity, turnaround time (TAT), and legal compliance targets. The Senior Team Leader drives operational excellence through effective workforce planning, operational governance, risk management, continuous improvement, and people development while partnering closely with Legal, Content Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure business continuity and operational success.

Key Responsibilities:

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop Team Leaders to consistently achieve operational, quality, compliance, and people performance objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, talent assessments, and succession planning activities.
  • Drive employee engagement, retention, leadership capability development, and recognition initiatives.
  • Build a high-performing leadership team capable of delivering consistent business results.

Operations Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day delivery of multiple Content Protection Operations workstreams, ensuring the efficient, accurate, and compliant processing of copyright infringement and legal claims.
  • Ensure achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Average Handling Time (AHT), Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defect (QD), productivity, turnaround time (TAT), backlog, and operational performance targets.
  • Monitor operational health through performance dashboards and proactively mitigate operational risks impacting business performance.
  • Establish and maintain operational governance by ensuring adherence to client policies, standard operating procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead operational readiness for new initiatives, policy changes, and business requirements.

Legal Compliance, Quality & Risk Management

  • Ensure all infringement claims are processed in accordance with applicable copyright laws, legal requirements, Spotify policies, and operational procedures.
  • Partner with Legal, Quality, and Content Operations teams to maintain high decision accuracy and operational compliance.
  • Drive initiatives to minimize Critical Fail (CF) and Quality Defects (QD) through proactive coaching, calibration sessions, quality governance, and root cause analysis.
  • Lead corrective and preventive action plans resulting from quality reviews, compliance audits, operational risks, and recurring defects.
  • Maintain audit readiness and promote a culture of compliance, operational discipline, and continuous quality improvement.

Workforce Management & Capacity Planning

  • Partner with Workforce Management (WFM) to develop short- and long-term staffing strategies aligned with forecasted demand, business priorities, and operational targets.
  • Analyze workload trends, case volumes, productivity, backlog, shrinkage, and staffing models to forecast capacity requirements and mitigate operational risks.
  • Optimize workforce utilization through effective resource allocation, schedule optimization, cross-training, and workload balancing while consistently achieving SLA, AHT, Quality, Compliance, and productivity objectives.
  • Develop contingency and business continuity plans to effectively manage volume fluctuations, operational disruptions, and evolving business requirements.
  • Utilize workforce analytics to support hiring plans, organizational design, budget forecasting, and long-term workforce strategy.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze operational and business performance metrics to identify trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions to improve Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defects (QD), AHT, productivity, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive process standardization, documentation improvements, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability, decision accuracy, and operational effectiveness.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance while reducing operational risk and manual effort.
  • Support implementation of new tools, technologies, workflows, and operational initiatives.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Legal, Content Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Present operational performance, quality trends, compliance metrics, workforce insights, risks, and strategic recommendations during business reviews and leadership meetings.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex operational, workforce, compliance, and quality-related issues requiring executive oversight.
  • Influence strategic decisions through data-driven insights, operational expertise, and collaborative problem-solving.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Management, Law, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of five (5) years [external applicant] or 12 months [internal applicant] of progressive experience in Content Protection Operations, Copyright Enforcement, Trust & Safety, Legal Operations, Digital Rights Management (DRM), Intellectual Property, or a related domain.
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing end-to-end copyright infringement and legal claims, including complex, high-risk, and escalated cases involving global digital content platforms.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of leadership experience managing Team Leaders or multiple operational teams within a BPO, shared services, or global operations environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in copyright regulations, digital rights management, content protection policies, legal compliance, and operational governance.
  • Proven success delivering results across SLA, Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defects (QD), AHT, Productivity, Compliance, Backlog Management, and Workforce Efficiency metrics.
  • Strong analytical and strategic planning skills with experience in workforce planning, capacity management, root cause analysis, risk management, and operational governance.
  • Experience leading operational transformation, continuous improvement, automation, and AI adoption initiatives.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, executive presentation, coaching, and leadership development skills.

Additional Information:

Applicants who has experience managing You Tube, Google, Content Moderation is good to have.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking an attentive and goal-oriented person to join us as a Technical Support Engineer 1 typically provides entry-level technical support for diagnosing, reproducing, and fixing software and hardware issues. It includes troubleshoot protocols running on NetApp hardware to assist Customer with problem isolation and resolution. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Technical Support Engineers assist NetApp Customers by providing a range of technical support including:

  • Resolve Customer problems via the telephone, the web or AutoSupport.
  • Research Customer issues in a timely manner and follow up directly with the Customer with recommendations and action plans.
  • Escalate cases to other more senior Technical Support Engineers and/or Escalation Engineers when the problem is too complex or falls out of specific area of expertise.
  • Leverage internal technical expertise, including higher-level engineers, knowledge base, and other internal tools, to add to knowledge base in order to provide solutions to customer issues.
  • Create new knowledgebase articles to capture new learning for reuse throughout the center.
  • Participate in technical communication within the Technical Support Engineering team to learn about new technologies and complimentary storage applications.
  • Gain knowledge and expertise through hand-on experience, self-study, and through a variety of learning environments. Initial focus is on learning NetApp’s proprietary operating system, OnTap, and troubleshooting NetApp hardware issues.
  • Some opportunity, after training, to work on small volumes of Top Enterprise Accounts (NetApp’s highest priority customers) and SupportEdge Premium cases (customers with a higher level of support agreement).

Qualifications:

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English (B2 or higher)
  • Good interpersonal communication and Customer service skills are needed in order to work successfully with customers in high stress and or ambiguous situations.
  • Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and understanding how to utilize them in a customer facing environment.
  • Ability to follow standard research and troubleshooting processes.

Basic understanding of some of the following protocols and applications:

  • Storage (NAS / SAN)
  • Networking - TCP/IP
  • Hardware / RAID
  • Operating Systems (Windows / Unix)
  • Data Protection (Backup and recovery)

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

Network Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking solutions.
  • Develop and maintain network architecture standards, diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Evaluate and recommend network technologies, hardware, and software solutions.
  • Lead network upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

Operations & Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for complex network incidents and outages.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.
  • Ensure network availability, performance, and reliability through proactive monitoring and maintenance.
  • Participate in on-call support and incident response activities as required.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, NAC, segmentation, and secure remote access.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Support compliance, audit, and risk management requirements.
  • Maintain network security standards and best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure Integration

  • Design and support connectivity to Azure, AWS, GCP and OCI.
  • Integrate network services with enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  • Support hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud networking architectures.
  • Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code solutions where appropriate.

Project Leadership

  • Lead technical aspects of network-related projects from planning through implementation.
  • Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across the team.
  • Develop project plans, implementation procedures, and testing strategies.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, wireless networking, and network security technologies.
  • Experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience supporting large-scale and mission-critical environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with Cloud networking.
  • Experience with SD-WAN and network automation technologies.
  • Knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible.
  • Industry certifications such as CCIE, CISSP, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or AWS Advanced Networking Specialty.

Technical Skills

  • BGP, MPLS, and routing protocols
  • Layer 2/Layer 3 switching technologies
  • Wireless networking and controller-based architectures
  • VPN, Firewall, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust technologies
  • SD-WAN and Internet connectivity solutions
  • Cloud native and hybrid-cloud networking
  • Network monitoring and performance management tools
  • Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies

Key Competencies

  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Technical leadership and mentorship
  • Project execution and delivery
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Collaboration across infrastructure and security teams
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Customer service and operational excellence

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Role is expected to work US Eastern Standard Time hours

job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a Technical Account Manager to play a key role in driving customer success, service excellence, and technical relationship management across enterprise customer environments. This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, customer-facing experience, operational excellence, and stakeholder management skills. The ideal candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while partnering closely with Engineering, Support, Product, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful service delivery and customer outcomes.

The Technical Account Manager performs a wide range of duties including some or all the following:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for designated customer accounts, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and technical teams while maintaining effective communication across multiple organizational levels.
  • Monitor support activities, service trends, operational metrics, and customer health indicators to proactively identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for designated accounts, coordinating resolution efforts and driving critical issues to closure.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between Support, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and other internal teams to resolve technical challenges and improve customer experience.
  • Drive customer communication during escalations, incidents, operational issues, and service-impacting events.
  • Identify barriers to product adoption, customer success, or operational efficiency and partner with internal teams to implement improvements.
  • Support transition activities from implementation to production support, ensuring operational readiness and successful customer onboarding.
  • Develop and maintain account-specific operational processes, best practices, and service management activities aligned with organizational standards.
  • Lead customer reviews, operational discussions, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to technical teams while supporting knowledge sharing and operational maturity.
  • Communicate customer feedback, requirements, risks, and opportunities to internal stakeholders including Product Management, Engineering, and Leadership teams.
  • Support global operations including occasional travel, on-call responsibilities, or work outside standard business hours when required.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, customer success, service delivery, solution engineering, or related customer-facing technical roles.
  • Previous experience in customer-facing positions such as Technical Account Manager, Program Manager, Project Manager, Incident Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or similar roles.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and managing high-touch customer relationships.
  • Experience with cloud environments, SaaS platforms, production operations, or enterprise software environments is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support processes, escalation management, incident management, and service delivery best practices.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data, metrics, and trends to drive decisions and influence outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing priorities, and perform in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with experience navigating complex technical and operational challenges.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and international customers is preferred.
  • Ability to manage customer expectations while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Additional Information:

Hybrid work model: 3 days working from home and 2 days onsite at our Torre Krystal offices in Bogotá.

Job Description:

Years of Experience Required:

Level 1: 1 year to 2 years
Level 2: 2 years to 4 years
Level 3: 4 years to 7 years

Location: Chennai, India (Mandatory Work from Office)
Shift: US Night Shift (5 Days a Week)

Role #1

US Payroll - Level 2 & Level 3

We are seeking an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist / Lead to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for US payroll operations. This role is responsible for ensuring compliant, accurate, and efficient payroll delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position offers exposure to complex multi-state payroll, global governance, advanced system operations, and leadership opportunities.

The Lead will additionally review and validate pre-payroll inputs, analyze payroll outputs, administer post-payroll activities, mentor junior specialists, and ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs. This role requires night shift support with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

Role #2

Payroll Tax Analyst – Level 3

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Tax Analyst with strong experience in US Payroll Tax and multi-state payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end payroll tax processing & reconciliations
  • Prepare/review Federal, State & Local tax filings (941, 940, W-2, W-2C)
  • Handle tax notices, amendments & compliance deadlines
  • Support year-end payroll tax activities
  • Drive process improvements & stakeholder coordination

What We’re Looking For:

  • 4+ years of Payroll / Payroll Tax experience
  • Strong knowledge of US payroll tax regulations
  • Experience in multi-state payroll environment
  • Hands-on with ADP, Workday or similar payroll tools
  • Strong Excel & analytical skills

Role #3

Benefits Administration - Level 1

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and dependable Compensation Specialist to join our HR Shared Services team in Chennai. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate and compliant administration of compensation and benefits processes for the US region. The specialist will work extensively with Workday Compensation modules, support annual compensation cycles, maintain data accuracy, and deliver exceptional employee experience through timely and precise operations.

This is a work-from-office, night-shift role with rotational weekly offs.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of US compensation regulations, hands-on experience with Workday Compensation, strong analytical capability, and a commitment to operational excellence. This role requires working night shifts with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

Level 1

The L1 Hotline Support role is responsible for being the first point of contact for compliance and incident-related queries received via hotline, email, or ticketing tools. The individual will take calls, capture accurate information, create incidents, and route requests as per defined SOPs.

Level 2

The L2 Hotline Support role handles complex hotline interactions, performs advanced triage, validates incident details, and ensures correct categorization, prioritization, and resolution routing. The role also supports quality checks, coaching of L1 resources, and escalation management.

This role ensures seamless execution of performance management, succession planning, talent data integrity, and recruitment support processes.

This role also requires mentoring junior specialists, managing escalations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Operations. This position supports US time zones, requires night shift work with rotational weekly offs, and is based in our Chennai office.

HR Administration

Level 1

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and motivated HR Operations Specialist to join our high-performing HR Shared Services (HRSS) team supporting the US region. This role is essential in ensuring accurate execution of core HR processes, maintaining compliance, and delivering a seamless employee experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational discipline, foundational knowledge of US HR practices, and the ability to support recruitment operations while collaborating effectively across teams.

Level 2

We are seeking experienced and highly capable Senior HR Operations Specialists to drive delivery excellence within our high-performing HR Shared Services (HRSS) organization supporting the US market. This role requires deep subject matter expertise in HR processes, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to ensure compliance with US labor laws and regulatory standards.

The Senior Associate will manage core HR processes and employee support. This role requires night shift support with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.
